	priority = 1000

	lawgroup_citizenship = {
		law_subjecthood = strongly_approve
		law_ethnostate = approve
		law_national_supremacy = strongly_approve

		law_cosmopolitanism = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_hellenoturkism = neutral	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_migration = {
		law_closed_borders = neutral
		law_migration_controls = strongly_approve
		law_no_migration_controls = strongly_disapprove
	}

    lawgroup_internal_security = {
		law_no_home_affairs = strongly_disapprove
		law_national_guard = strongly_approve
		law_secret_police = strongly_approve
		law_guaranteed_liberties = strongly_disapprove
		law_gendarmerie = strongly_approve
		law_garde_nationale = strongly_approve	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_free_speech = {
		law_outlawed_dissent = strongly_approve
		law_censorship = approve
		law_right_of_assembly = strongly_disapprove
		law_protected_speech = strongly_disapprove

########## bpm_leader_ideologies.txt ##########

# ideology_traditionalist
REPLACE:ideology_traditionalist = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_traditionalist.dds"
	
	character_ideology = yes
	show_in_list = yes
	
	lawgroup_citizenship = {
		law_ethnostate = neutral
		law_national_supremacy = neutral
		law_racial_segregation = neutral
		law_cultural_exclusion = neutral
		law_multicultural = strongly_disapprove
		law_subjecthood = approve
		law_cosmopolitanism = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_hellenoturkism = neutral	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_rights_of_women = {
		law_no_womens_rights = approve
		law_women_own_property = neutral
		law_women_in_the_workplace = disapprove
		law_womens_suffrage = strongly_disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_church_and_state = {
		law_state_religion = approve
		law_freedom_of_conscience = disapprove
		law_total_separation = strongly_disapprove
		law_state_atheism = strongly_disapprove
		law_religious_pluralism = disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_repeatable_religion = {
		law_repeatable_religion_promote_state_religion = approve
		law_repeatable_religion_anti_secular_reaction = strongly_approve
		law_repeatable_religion_promote_secular_values = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_religion_anti_religious_violence = strongly_disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_repeatable_culture = {
		law_repeatable_culture_invite_foreign_experts = disapprove
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_democratic_values = disapprove
		law_repeatable_culture_affirmative_action = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_socialist_values = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_patriotic_values = approve
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_absolutist_values = approve
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_ultranationalist_values = approve
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_traditionalist_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 50
		# more likely for the right
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_traditionalist = yes
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# more likely for rural
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_rural_institutional = yes
			}
			add = 25
		}
		# less likely for urban
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_urban_institutional = yes
			}
			add = -25
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_traditionalist_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					owner = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_atheism
					}
				}
			}
			religion ?= ROOT.owner.religion
		}

		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_womens_rights
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_religion
				NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_multicultural }
			}
		}
	}
	lawgroup_discriminated_pop = {
		law_no_codified_discrimination = neutral
		law_racial_hierarchy = neutral	# derived
		law_violent_suppresion = neutral	# derived
	}
}

# ideology_nihilist
REPLACE:ideology_nihilist = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_nihilist.dds"
	
	character_ideology = yes
	show_in_list = yes

	lawgroup_governance_principles = {
		law_theocracy = strongly_disapprove
		law_monarchy = disapprove
		law_presidential_republic = neutral
		law_parliamentary_republic = neutral
		law_council_republic = neutral
		law_corporatocracy = disapprove	# laws+
	}

	lawgroup_church_and_state = {
		law_state_religion = strongly_disapprove
		law_freedom_of_conscience = disapprove
		law_total_separation = approve
		law_state_atheism = strongly_approve
		law_religious_pluralism = disapprove	# laws+
	}

	lawgroup_repeatable_religion = {
		law_repeatable_religion_promote_state_religion = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_religion_anti_secular_reaction = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_religion_promote_secular_values = strongly_approve
		law_repeatable_religion_anti_religious_violence = approve
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_nihilist_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 25
		# more likely if the IG is unhappy with the monarchy
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					bpm_country_is_republic = no
				}
				ig_approval < 0
			}
			add = 50
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					bpm_country_is_republic = no
				}
			}
			add = -50
		}
		# this is not very relevant if you're a republic with religious freedom
		if = { 
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						bpm_country_laws_are_moralist = yes
						bpm_country_is_republic = no
					}
				}
			}
			add = -100
		}
		# will emerge to counter a powerful Devout IG
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
						is_powerful = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# agrarian populists and anarchist are more likely to be nihilists
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						bpm_country_laws_are_moralist = yes
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
					}
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_agrarian_populists
					bpm_ig_is_anarchist = yes
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 
				has_variable = nihilism_var 
			}
			add = 150
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 
				has_variable = big_nihilism_var
			}
			add = 200
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_nihilist_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitators should have an ideology at odds with current laws
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				bpm_country_is_republic = yes
				OR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_atheism
					country_has_state_religion = rel:atheist
				}
			}
		}
		# Monarchs cannot be republicans
		NAND = {
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
			}
			OR = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
				is_heir_of_own_country = yes
				interest_group = { bpm_ig_is_state_institutional = yes }
			}
		}
		owner = {
			has_technology_researched = empiricism
		}
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 25
		# more likely if the IG is unhappy with the monarchy
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					bpm_country_is_republic = no
				}
				interest_group = {
					ig_approval < 0
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					bpm_country_is_republic = no
				}
			}
			add = -50
		}
		# this is not very relevant if you're a republic with religious freedom
		if = { 
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						bpm_country_laws_are_moralist = yes
						bpm_country_is_republic = no
					}
				}
			}
			add = -100
		}
		# will emerge to counter a powerful Devout IG
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
						is_powerful = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# agrarian populists and anarchist are more likely to be nihilists
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						bpm_country_laws_are_moralist = yes
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
					}
				}
				interest_group = {
					OR = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_agrarian_populists
						bpm_ig_is_anarchist = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 
				interest_group = { 
					has_variable = nihilism_var 
				}
			}
			add = 150
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 
				interest_group = {
					has_variable = big_nihilism_var
				}
			}
			add = 200
		}
	}
}

# ideology_republican_leader
REPLACE:ideology_republican_leader = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_republican.dds"
	
	character_ideology = yes
	
	lawgroup_governance_principles = {
		law_presidential_republic = approve
		law_parliamentary_republic = approve
		law_council_republic = disapprove
		law_monarchy = disapprove
		law_theocracy = disapprove
		law_corporatocracy = neutral
	}
	
	lawgroup_distribution_of_power = {
		law_universal_suffrage = strongly_approve
		law_census_voting = approve
		law_wealth_voting = approve
		law_landed_voting = neutral
		law_oligarchy = disapprove
		law_autocracy = disapprove
		law_anarchy = strongly_disapprove
		law_technocracy = neutral
		law_military_junta = neutral
		law_organic_democracy = strongly_disapprove
		law_proletariat_dictatorship = strongly_disapprove
		law_ecclesiarchy = disapprove
		law_weighted_universal_voting = strongly_approve	# derived
	}	

	lawgroup_bureaucracy = {
		law_elected_bureaucrats = approve
		law_appointed_bureaucrats = neutral
		law_hereditary_bureaucrats = disapprove
		law_meritocratic_bureaucracy = neutral
		law_gwageo = neutral	# derived
		law_mestnichestvo = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_militarisierung_der_burokratie = neutral	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_repeatable_culture = {
		law_repeatable_culture_invite_foreign_experts = approve
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_democratic_values = strongly_approve
		law_repeatable_culture_affirmative_action = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_socialist_values = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_patriotic_values = approve
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_absolutist_values = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_ultranationalist_values = strongly_disapprove
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_republican_leader_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 25
		# more likely if the IG is unhappy with the monarchy
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					bpm_country_is_republic = no
				}
				ig_approval < 0
			}
			add = 50
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					bpm_country_is_republic = no
				}
			}
			add = -50
		}
		# this is not very relevant if you're a republic with religious freedom
		if = { 
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						bpm_country_laws_are_moralist = yes
						bpm_country_is_republic = no
					}
				}
			}
			add = -100
		}
		# will emerge to counter a powerful landowners IG
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
						is_powerful = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# agrarian populists and anarchist are more likely to be nihilists
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						bpm_country_laws_are_moralist = yes
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
					}
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_agrarian_populists
					bpm_ig_is_radical_liberal = yes
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if you win the Two Spains as the liberals.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = spa_two_spains_liberal_victory
			}
			add = 25
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if you succeed in Portugal's Second Liberalism.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = por_second_liberalism_victory
			}
			add = 25
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if the Hungarian Revolution was successful.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = hungarian_revolution_increased_liberalism
			}
			add = 25
		}

		# Pedro JE victory
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = brz_enduring_empire
				}
			}
			add = -50
		}

		# 1848
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_global_variable = peoples_springtime_happening
					capital = {
					 	OR = {
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_north_germany_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_germany_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_england_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_iberia_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_france_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_occitania_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_rhine_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_italy_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_poland_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_danubia_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_balkans_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_baltic_old
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { has_modifier = post_revolutionary_fervor }
			}
			multiply = { value = 1.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { has_modifier = counter_revolutionary_fervor }
			}
			multiply = { value = 0.5 }
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_republican_leader_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitators should have an ideology at odds with current laws
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {bpm_country_is_republic = yes}
		}
		# Monarchs cannot be republicans
		NAND = {
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
			}
			OR = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
				is_heir_of_own_country = yes
				interest_group = { bpm_ig_is_state_institutional = yes }
			}
		}
		owner = {
			has_technology_researched = empiricism
		}
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 25
		# more likely if the IG is unhappy with the monarchy
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					bpm_country_is_republic = no
				}
				interest_group = {
					ig_approval < 0
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					bpm_country_is_republic = no
				}
			}
			add = -500
		}
		# this is not very relevant if you're a democractic republic 
		if = { 
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						bpm_country_laws_are_liberal_democratic = yes
						bpm_country_is_republic = no
					}
				}
			}
			add = -100
		}
		# will emerge to counter a powerful Landowners IG
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
						is_powerful = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# agrarian populists and anarchist are more likely to be nihilists
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						bpm_country_laws_are_moralist = yes
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
					}
				}
				interest_group = {
					OR = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_agrarian_populists
						bpm_ig_is_radical_liberal = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if the Dreyfusards won.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = dreyfusard_victory
			}
			add = 25
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if you win the Two Spains as the liberals.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = spa_two_spains_liberal_victory
			}
			add = 25
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if the Hungarian Revolution was successful.
		if = {
			limit = {

			}
			add = 50
		}

			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = brz_enduring_empire
				}
			}
			add = -50
		}

		# 1848
		if = {

				owner = {
					has_global_variable = peoples_springtime_happening
					capital = {
					 	OR = {
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_north_germany_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_germany_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_england_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_iberia_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_france_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_occitania_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_rhine_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_italy_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_poland_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_danubia_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_balkans_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_baltic_old
						}
					}
				}

				value = 2

		if = {

				owner = { has_modifier = post_revolutionary_fervor }
			}
			multiply = { value = 1.5 }

# ideology_radical
REPLACE:ideology_radical = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_radical.dds"
	
	character_ideology = yes
	show_in_list = yes

	lawgroup_governance_principles = {
		law_monarchy = strongly_disapprove
		law_theocracy = strongly_disapprove
		law_council_republic = disapprove		
		law_presidential_republic = approve
		law_parliamentary_republic = approve
		law_corporatocracy = disapprove
	}
	
	lawgroup_distribution_of_power = {
		law_universal_suffrage = strongly_approve
		law_census_voting = approve
		law_wealth_voting = neutral
		law_landed_voting = disapprove
		law_anarchy = strongly_disapprove
		law_oligarchy = strongly_disapprove
		law_autocracy = strongly_disapprove
		law_technocracy = disapprove
		law_military_junta = disapprove
		law_organic_democracy = strongly_disapprove
		law_proletariat_dictatorship = disapprove
		law_ecclesiarchy = disapprove
		law_weighted_universal_voting = approve	# laws+
	}

	lawgroup_free_speech = {
		law_protected_speech = strongly_approve
		law_right_of_assembly = approve
		law_censorship = disapprove
		law_outlawed_dissent = strongly_disapprove
	}
	
	lawgroup_internal_security = {
		law_guaranteed_liberties = strongly_approve
		law_no_home_affairs = approve
		law_national_guard = strongly_disapprove
		law_secret_police = strongly_disapprove
		law_gendarmerie = disapprove
		law_garde_nationale = strongly_disapprove	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_repeatable_politics = {
		law_repeatable_politics_modernize_bureaucracy = strongly_approve
		law_repeatable_politics_military_purge = disapprove
		law_repeatable_politics_bureaucratic_purge = disapprove
		law_repeatable_politics_popular_concessions = approve
		law_repeatable_politics_anti_corruption_drive = approve
		law_repeatable_politics_great_terror = strongly_disapprove
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_radical_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = {
			value = 100
			# more likely for radicals
			if = {
				limit = {
					bpm_ig_is_radical_liberal = yes
				}
				add = 120
			}
			# less likely for regular liberals
			if = {
				limit = {
					bpm_ig_is_moderate_liberal = yes
				}
				add = -70
			}
			# more likely for populists
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						bpm_ig_is_republican = yes
						bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
					}
				}
				add = 40
			}
			# more likely for trade unions
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				}
				add = 40
			}
			# Unlikely for socialists after first intl
			if = {
				limit = {
					bpm_ig_is_socialist = yes
					has_global_variable = first_intl_chain_complete_var
				}
				add = -50
			}
			# more likely if issues are relevant and people are angry
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						bpm_country_laws_are_very_undemocratic = yes
						any_scope_state = {
							is_incorporated = yes
							turmoil >= 0.25
						}
					}
				}
				add = 60
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						bpm_country_laws_are_moderately_undemocratic = yes
						any_scope_state = {
							is_incorporated = yes
							turmoil >= 0.4
						}
					}
				}
				add = 50
			}
			# less likely if issues are not relevant
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						bpm_country_laws_are_very_undemocratic = no
					}
				}
				add = -75
			}
			# very unlikely for socialists after second intl
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						bpm_ig_is_party_socialist = yes
						bpm_ig_is_anarchist = yes
					}
					owner = {
						has_technology_researched = socialism
					}
				}
				add = -225
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						has_global_variable = bpm_peoples_springtime_happening
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe
					}
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 3
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = { has_modifier = post_revolutionary_fervor }
				}
				multiply = { value = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = { has_modifier = counter_revolutionary_fervor }
				}
				multiply = { value = 0.5 }
			}
			# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if the Dreyfusards won.
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = dreyfusard_victory
				}
				add = 10
			}
			# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if you win the Two Spains as the liberals.
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = spa_two_spains_liberal_victory
				}
				add = 10
			}
			# less likely if conservative
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						bpm_ig_is_moderate_conservative = yes
						bpm_ig_is_traditionalist = yes
					}
				}
				add = -100
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				}
				add = -500
			}
			# Pedro JE victory
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						has_variable = brz_enduring_empire
					}
				}
				add = -25
			}
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        ideology_radical_valid_trigger = yes
		# Agitators should have an ideology at odds with current laws
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				bpm_country_is_bourgeois_republic = yes
				bpm_country_laws_are_liberal_democratic = yes
				bpm_country_has_unfree_labor = no
			}
		}
		# Monarchs cannot be republicans
		NAND = {
			owner = { bpm_country_is_republic = no }
			OR = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
				is_heir_of_own_country = yes
				interest_group = { bpm_ig_is_state_institutional = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 50
	}
	lawgroup_education_system = {
		law_military_schools = disapprove	# laws+
		law_seodang = disapprove	# derived
	}
	lawgroup_ballot_system = {
		law_semi_constitutional = disapprove	# laws+
		law_non_secret_ballot = neutral	# laws+
		law_secret_ballot = approve	# laws+
		law_direct_democracy = approve	# laws+
		law_no_election = strongly_disapprove	# derived
	}
}

		law_repeatable_culture_affirmative_action = disapprove

		law_repeatable_culture_promote_patriotic_values = approve
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_absolutist_values = disapprove
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_ultranationalist_values = disapprove

		law_repeatable_politics_bureaucratic_purge = disapprove

			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						bpm_country_laws_are_racist = yes
						bpm_country_laws_are_patriarchal = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = -100
		}
		# less likely among more progressive IG's if they're angry
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_left_wing = yes
				}
				ig_approval < 0
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# less likely among radical IGs
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_radical_left = yes
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# more likely when issues are relevant
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						bpm_country_laws_are_racist = yes
						bpm_country_laws_are_patriarchal = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# less likely if conservative
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_right_wing = yes
				is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# Pedro JE victory
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = brz_enduring_empire
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_reformer_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitators should have an ideology at odds with current laws
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_cultural_exclusion
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_compulsory_primary_school
				NOT = { bpm_country_has_unfree_labor = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 100
		# less likely when issues are not relevant
	}
	lawgroup_discriminated_pop = {
		law_no_codified_discrimination = strongly_approve
		law_racial_hierarchy = disapprove	# laws+
		law_violent_suppresion = disapprove	# laws+
	}
}

# ideology_physiocrat
REPLACE:ideology_physiocrat = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_laissez_faire.dds"
	
	character_ideology = yes
	show_in_list = yes

	lawgroup_economic_system = {
		law_traditionalism = strongly_disapprove
		law_interventionism = disapprove
		law_agrarianism = strongly_approve
		law_industry_banned = neutral
		law_laissez_faire = approve
		law_cooperative_ownership = strongly_disapprove
		law_command_economy = strongly_disapprove
		law_extraction_economy = strongly_disapprove
		law_class_collaboration = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_early_industrialization = disapprove	# derived
		law_state_capitalism = neutral	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_land_reform = {
		law_serfdom = strongly_disapprove
		law_tenant_farmers = approve
		law_peasant_proprietorship = neutral
		law_collectivized_agriculture = approve
		law_commercialized_agriculture = disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_taxation = {
		law_consumption_based_taxation = disapprove
		law_land_based_taxation = strongly_approve
		law_per_capita_based_taxation = disapprove
		law_proportional_taxation = disapprove
		law_graduated_taxation = strongly_disapprove
		law_no_income_tax = disapprove	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_trade_policy = {		
		law_protectionism = disapprove
		law_mercantilism = neutral		
		law_isolationism = disapprove
		law_free_trade = strongly_approve
		law_sakoku_shugi = disapprove	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_repeatable_economy = {
		law_repeatable_economy_liberalization = neutral
		law_repeatable_economy_agricultural_investment = strongly_approve
		law_repeatable_economy_peasant_corvee = approve
		law_repeatable_economy_public_works = approve
		law_repeatable_economy_forced_industrialization = strongly_disapprove
	}

	
	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_physiocrat_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 100
		# less likely among more progressive IG's if they're angry
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_left_wing = yes
				}
				ig_approval < 0
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# less likely among radical IGs
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_radical_left = yes
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# more likely in premodern lawsets
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_traditionalism
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
					}
				}
			}
			add = 75
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_agrarian = yes
				is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
			}
			add = 15
		}
		
		# less likely if reactionary or capitalist
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_reactionaries
					is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
				}
			}
			add = -75
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_physiocrat_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitators should have an ideology at odds with current laws
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_agrarianism
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_land_based_taxation
				NOT = { bpm_country_has_unfree_labor = yes }
			}
		}
		
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 100
		# less likely when issues are not relevant
	}
}

# ideology_abolitionist
REPLACE:ideology_abolitionist = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_abolitionist.dds"
	
	character_ideology = yes
	
	lawgroup_slavery = {
		law_slavery_banned = strongly_approve
		law_legacy_slavery = disapprove
		law_debt_slavery = disapprove #strongly_disapprove
		law_colonial_slavery = disapprove
		law_slave_trade = strongly_disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_land_reform = {
		law_serfdom = strongly_disapprove
	}
	
	# Character scope
	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_abolitionist_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 50
		if = {
			limit = { bpm_ig_is_left_wing = yes }
			add = 100
		}	
	
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = c:USA
				owner = { 
					c:USA = THIS 
					NOT = { has_variable = csa_will_spawn_var }
				}
			}
			add = 150
		}
	}

	# Character scope
	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_abolitionist_valid_trigger = yes 
    	}
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 50
		if = {
			limit = { interest_group = { bpm_ig_is_left_wing = yes } }
			add = 100
		}	
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = c:USA
				owner = { 
					c:USA = THIS 
					NOT = { has_variable = csa_will_spawn_var }
				}
			}
			add = 150
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = tactful }
			add = 75
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = bigoted }
			add = -100
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = cruel }
			add = -25
		}	
	}
	lawgroup_discriminated_pop = {
		law_no_codified_discrimination = neutral	# laws+
		law_racial_hierarchy = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
		law_violent_suppresion = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
	}
}

# ideology_pacifist
REPLACE:ideology_pacifist = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_pacifist.dds"
	
	character_ideology = yes
	show_in_list = yes

	lawgroup_army_model = {
		law_national_militia = approve
		law_professional_army = disapprove
		law_peasant_levies = disapprove
		law_mass_conscription = disapprove
		law_amabutho = disapprove	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_navy_model = {
		law_merchant_navy = approve
		law_jeune_ecole = strongly_disapprove
		law_professional_navy = strongly_disapprove
		law_diplomatic_navy = neutral
	}

	lawgroup_colonization = {		
		law_no_colonial_affairs = approve
		law_frontier_colonization = strongly_disapprove
		law_colonial_resettlement = strongly_disapprove
		law_colonial_exploitation = strongly_disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_foreign_policy = {
		law_ultramilitarism = strongly_disapprove
		law_jingoism = strongly_disapprove
		law_flexible_foreign_policy = disapprove
		law_justum_bellum = neutral
		law_dove_politics = strongly_approve
		law_armed_neutrality = approve
		law_disarmed_nation = strongly_approve
		law_premodern_diplomacy = disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_repeatable_military = {
 		law_repeatable_military_military_reform = neutral
 		law_repeatable_military_parades_and_drills = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_military_improve_soldier_conditions = approve
 		law_repeatable_military_army_defunding = approve
 		law_repeatable_military_war_propaganda = strongly_disapprove
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_pacifist_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 50
		# emerges to counter powerful armed forces
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					ig:ig_armed_forces = {
						is_powerful = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 100
		}
		# less likely if not very militaristic
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					bpm_country_laws_are_militaristic = no
				}
			}
			add = -50
		}
		# less likely if issues are not relevant
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					bpm_country_laws_are_pacifistic = yes
				}
			}
			add = -50
		}
		# more likely if a war you started isn't going well
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_at_war = yes
					any_scope_war = {
						attacker_warleader = { this = ROOT.owner }
						has_war_support = {
							target = root.owner
							value < 0
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = 100
		}
		# more likely with devastation in incorporated states
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_scope_state = {
						is_incorporated = yes
						devastation > 20
					}
				}
			}
			add = 200
		}
		# less likely if patriotic
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_patriotic = yes
			}
			add = -100
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_pacifist_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitators should have an ideology at odds with current laws
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = { bpm_country_laws_are_pacifistic = yes }
		}
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 50
	}
}

# ideology_jingoist_leader
REPLACE:ideology_jingoist_leader = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_jingoist.dds"
	
	character_ideology = yes
	
	lawgroup_army_model = {
		law_mass_conscription = strongly_approve
		law_professional_army = approve
		law_national_militia = neutral
		law_peasant_levies = disapprove
		law_amabutho = disapprove	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_navy_model = {
		law_merchant_navy = disapprove
		law_jeune_ecole = strongly_approve
		law_professional_navy = strongly_approve
		law_diplomatic_navy = neutral
	}

	lawgroup_colonization = {		
		law_no_colonial_affairs = neutral
		law_frontier_colonization = approve
		law_colonial_resettlement = approve
		law_colonial_exploitation = strongly_approve
	}

	lawgroup_foreign_policy = {
		law_ultramilitarism = approve
		law_jingoism = strongly_approve
		law_flexible_foreign_policy = neutral
		law_justum_bellum = neutral
		law_dove_politics = strongly_disapprove
		law_armed_neutrality = disapprove
		law_disarmed_nation = strongly_disapprove
		law_premodern_diplomacy = strongly_disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_repeatable_military = {
 		law_repeatable_military_military_reform = approve
 		law_repeatable_military_parades_and_drills = strongly_approve
		law_repeatable_military_improve_soldier_conditions = strongly_disapprove
 		law_repeatable_military_army_defunding = strongly_disapprove
 		law_repeatable_military_war_propaganda = strongly_approve
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_jingoist_leader_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 50
		# less likely if issues are not relevant
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					bpm_country_laws_are_very_militaristic = yes
				}
			}
			add = -100
		}
		# more likely if there's something to colonize nearby
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = {
					is_country_type = decentralized
					has_overlapping_interests = ROOT.owner
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# more likely if you border a rival
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_rival_country = {
						any_neighbouring_state = {
							owner = root.owner
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# more likely if you're the defender in a war
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_at_war = yes
					any_scope_war = {
						defender_warleader = { this = ROOT.owner }
					}
				}
			}
			add = 100
		}
		# less likely if left-wing
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_left_wing = yes
					bpm_ig_is_lower_institutional = yes
				}
			}
			add = -100
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_jingoist_leader_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitators should have an ideology at odds with current laws
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = { bpm_country_laws_are_very_militaristic = yes }
		}
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 50
	}
}

# ideology_royalist
REPLACE:ideology_royalist = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_royalist.dds"
	
	character_ideology = yes

	lawgroup_governance_principles = {
		law_monarchy = strongly_approve
		law_presidential_republic = disapprove
		law_parliamentary_republic = disapprove
		law_theocracy = disapprove
		law_council_republic = strongly_disapprove
		law_corporatocracy = strongly_disapprove
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_royalist_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 100
		# less likely in a theocracy
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_theocracy
				}
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# less likely in a republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy }
				}
			}
			add = -50
		}
		# less likely if IG is happy in a republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy }
				}
				ig_approval > 0
			}
			add = -50
		}
		# more likely if IG is happy in a monarchy
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
				ig_approval > 5
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# less likely if IG is unhappy in a monarchy
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
				ig_approval < 0
			}
			add = -50
		}
		# less likely if liberal
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_liberal = yes
					bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
				}
			}
			add = -75
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = brz_enduring_empire
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_royalist_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		interest_group ?= { bpm_interest_group_is_activated = yes }
		# Agitators should have an ideology at odds with current laws
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
			}
		}
		# no monarchists in countries with strong republican tradition
		owner = {
			NOR = {
				AND = {
					this = c:BRZ
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy }
					NOT = { has_variable = brz_enduring_empire }
				}
				has_variable = monarchy_stamped_out_var
				NOT = {
					any_interest_group = {
						bpm_ig_is_monarchist = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		NOR = {
			AND = {
				owner = {
					bpm_country_is_in_new_world = yes
					NOT = { this = c:BRZ }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				owner = { bpm_country_is_republic = yes }
				bpm_ig_is_state_institutional = yes
			}
		}
		interest_group = {
			NOR = {
				bpm_ig_is_republican = yes
				bpm_ig_is_socialist = yes
			}
		}
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 100
		# less likely in a theocracy
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_theocracy
				}
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# less likely in a republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy }
				}
			}
			add = -50
		}
		# less likely if IG is happy in a republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy }
				}
				interest_group = {
					ig_approval > 0
				}
			}
			add = -50
		}
		# more likely if IG is happy in a monarchy
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
				interest_group = {
					ig_approval > 5
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# less likely if IG is unhappy in a monarchy
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
				interest_group = {
					ig_approval < 0
				}
			}
			add = -50
		}
		# less likely if liberal
		if = {
			limit = {
				interest_group = {
					OR = {
						bpm_ig_is_liberal = yes
						bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = -75
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = brz_enduring_empire
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
	}
}

		law_proletariat_dictatorship = approve
		law_ecclesiarchy = strongly_disapprove
		law_weighted_universal_voting = neutral	# derived
	}
	
	lawgroup_economic_system = {
		law_traditionalism = strongly_disapprove
		law_interventionism = disapprove
		law_agrarianism = strongly_disapprove
		law_industry_banned = strongly_disapprove
		law_laissez_faire = strongly_disapprove
		law_cooperative_ownership = strongly_approve
		law_command_economy = approve
		law_extraction_economy = strongly_disapprove
		law_state_capitalism = neutral
		law_class_collaboration = strongly_approve	# derived
		law_early_industrialization = strongly_disapprove	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_land_reform = {
		law_serfdom = strongly_disapprove
		law_tenant_farmers = disapprove
		law_peasant_proprietorship = neutral
		law_collectivized_agriculture = approve
		law_commercialized_agriculture = neutral
	}

	lawgroup_labour_associations = {
		law_combination_acts = strongly_disapprove
		law_corporatized_unions = disapprove
		law_anti_strike_laws = strongly_disapprove
		law_right_to_associate = approve
		law_socialist_labor_unions = disapprove
		law_syndicalism = neutral
	}

	lawgroup_labor_rights = {		
		law_worker_protections = strongly_approve
		law_regulatory_bodies = neutral
		law_no_workers_rights = strongly_disapprove
		law_union_representation = strongly_approve
		law_paradox_employee_benefits = strongly_approve	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_slavery = {
		law_slavery_banned = approve
		law_debt_slavery = strongly_disapprove
		law_slave_trade = strongly_disapprove
		law_legacy_slavery = strongly_disapprove
		law_colonial_slavery = strongly_disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_repeatable_economy = {
		law_repeatable_economy_liberalization = disapprove
		law_repeatable_economy_agricultural_investment = neutral
		law_repeatable_economy_peasant_corvee = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_economy_public_works = approve
		law_repeatable_economy_forced_industrialization = disapprove
	}

	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_socialist_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 15
		# Unlikely after reformist/revolutionist split
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = local_revsocs_split_var
				}
			}
			add = -250
		}
		# more likely for socialists
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_socialist = yes
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# somewhat more likely for proletarians
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
			}
			add = 80
		}
		# very angry IG's more likely to turn to more radical socialism
		if = {
			limit = {
				ig_approval <= -5
			}
			add = 10
		}
		# more likely for discontent trade unions outside of council republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				ig_approval <= 0
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
				}
			}
			add = 80
		}
		# Syndicalism JE's influence shifts chances
		multiply = {
			if = {
				limit = { 
					owner = { 
						has_variable = bpm_je_syndicalism 
						var:bpm_je_syndicalism >= 33
					}
				}
				add = 66
				subtract = owner.var:bpm_je_syndicalism
				add = 33
				divide = 66
			} else = {
				value = 1
			}
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_socialist_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitators should have an ideology at odds with current laws
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_worker_protections
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_right_to_associate
			}
		}
		# Monarchs cannot be republicans
		NAND = {
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
			}
			OR = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
				is_heir_of_own_country = yes
			}
		}
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 15
	}
	lawgroup_ballot_system = {
		law_direct_democracy = strongly_approve	# derived
		law_no_election = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_non_secret_ballot = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_secret_ballot = strongly_approve	# derived
		law_semi_constitutional = strongly_disapprove	# derived
	}
}

# ideology_syndicalist
REPLACE:ideology_syndicalist = {

	character_ideology = yes
	show_in_list = yes

		law_regulatory_bodies = neutral
		law_no_workers_rights = strongly_disapprove
		law_union_representation = strongly_approve
		law_paradox_employee_benefits = strongly_approve	# derived

		law_tenant_farmers = disapprove
		law_peasant_proprietorship = neutral
		law_collectivized_agriculture = approve
		law_commercialized_agriculture = neutral
	}

	lawgroup_distribution_of_power = {
		law_anarchy = neutral
		law_universal_suffrage = strongly_approve
		law_census_voting = disapprove
		law_wealth_voting = strongly_disapprove
		law_landed_voting = strongly_disapprove

		law_proletariat_dictatorship = strongly_approve
		law_ecclesiarchy = strongly_disapprove
		law_weighted_universal_voting = neutral	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_economic_system = {
		law_traditionalism = strongly_disapprove
		law_interventionism = disapprove
		law_agrarianism = strongly_disapprove
		law_industry_banned = strongly_disapprove
		law_laissez_faire = strongly_disapprove
		law_cooperative_ownership = strongly_approve
		law_command_economy = approve
		law_extraction_economy = strongly_disapprove
		law_state_capitalism = disapprove
		law_class_collaboration = strongly_approve	# derived
		law_early_industrialization = strongly_disapprove	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_welfare = {
		law_poor_laws = strongly_disapprove
		law_no_social_security = strongly_disapprove
		law_wage_subsidies = approve
		law_old_age_pension = strongly_approve
		law_disability_insurance = strongly_approve
	}

	lawgroup_governance_principles = {
		law_monarchy = strongly_disapprove
		law_presidential_republic = approve
		law_parliamentary_republic = approve
		law_theocracy = strongly_disapprove
		law_council_republic = strongly_approve
		law_corporatocracy = strongly_disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_labour_associations = {
		law_combination_acts = strongly_disapprove
		law_corporatized_unions = disapprove
		law_anti_strike_laws = disapprove
		law_right_to_associate = approve
		law_socialist_labor_unions = disapprove
		law_syndicalism = strongly_approve
	}

	lawgroup_repeatable_economy = {
		law_repeatable_economy_liberalization = disapprove
		law_repeatable_economy_agricultural_investment = neutral
		law_repeatable_economy_peasant_corvee = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_economy_public_works = approve
		law_repeatable_economy_forced_industrialization = disapprove
	}

	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_syndicalist_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 15
		# Unlikely after reformist/revolutionist split
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = local_revsocs_split_var
				}
			}
			add = -250
		}
		# more likely for socialists
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_socialist = yes
			}
			add = 110
		}
		# somewhat more likely for proletarians
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
			}
			add = 80
		}
		# very angry IG's more likely to turn to more radical socialism
		if = {
			limit = {
				ig_approval <= -5
			}
			add = 10
		}
		# more likely for discontent trade unions outside of council republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				ig_approval <= 0
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
				}
			}
			add = 80
		}
		# More likely if syndicalism is legitimized or living under syndicalism
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_global_variable = bpm_syndicalism_legitimized
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_syndicalism
					}
				}
			}
			add = 110
		}
		# Syndicalism JE's influence shifts chances
		multiply = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { 
					owner = { has_variable = bpm_je_syndicalism }
					owner.var:bpm_je_syndicalism >= 33
				}
				add = owner.var:bpm_je_syndicalism
				subtract = 33
				divide = 66
			}
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_syndicalist_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitators should have an ideology at odds with current laws
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_worker_protections
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_syndicalism
			}
		}
		# Monarchs cannot be republicans
		NAND = {
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
			}
			OR = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
				is_heir_of_own_country = yes
			}
		}
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 15
	}
	lawgroup_ballot_system = {
		law_direct_democracy = strongly_approve	# derived
		law_no_election = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_non_secret_ballot = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_secret_ballot = strongly_approve	# derived
		law_semi_constitutional = strongly_disapprove	# derived
	}

# ideology_social_democrat
REPLACE:ideology_social_democrat = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_proletarian.dds"
	
	character_ideology = yes
	show_in_list = yes

	lawgroup_land_reform = {
		law_serfdom = strongly_disapprove
		law_tenant_farmers = disapprove
		law_peasant_proprietorship = neutral
		law_collectivized_agriculture = approve
		law_commercialized_agriculture = neutral
	}
	
	lawgroup_taxation = {
		law_consumption_based_taxation = disapprove
		law_land_based_taxation = strongly_disapprove
		law_per_capita_based_taxation = neutral
		law_proportional_taxation = approve
		law_graduated_taxation = strongly_approve
		law_no_income_tax = neutral	# laws+
	}

	lawgroup_education_system = {
		law_no_schools = strongly_disapprove
		law_religious_schools = disapprove
		law_private_schools = disapprove
		law_public_schools = strongly_approve
		law_military_schools = disapprove	# derived
		law_seodang = disapprove	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_labor_rights = {
		law_no_workers_rights = strongly_disapprove
		law_regulatory_bodies = approve
		law_worker_protections = strongly_approve
		law_union_representation = strongly_approve
		law_paradox_employee_benefits = strongly_approve	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_childrens_rights = {
		law_child_labor_allowed = strongly_disapprove
		law_restricted_child_labor = approve
		law_compulsory_primary_school = strongly_approve
		law_child_benefit = strongly_approve	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_welfare = {
		law_no_social_security = strongly_disapprove
		law_poor_laws = disapprove
		law_wage_subsidies = approve
		law_old_age_pension = strongly_approve
		law_disability_insurance = strongly_approve
	}

	lawgroup_labour_associations = {
		law_combination_acts = strongly_disapprove
		law_corporatized_unions = disapprove
		law_anti_strike_laws = disapprove
		law_right_to_associate = approve
		law_socialist_labor_unions = disapprove
		law_syndicalism = neutral
	}

	lawgroup_repeatable_economy = {
		law_repeatable_economy_liberalization = approve
		law_repeatable_economy_agricultural_investment = approve
		law_repeatable_economy_peasant_corvee = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_economy_public_works = approve
		law_repeatable_economy_forced_industrialization = strongly_disapprove
	}

	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_social_democrat_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 200
		# less likely for moderate liberals and committed socialists
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_moderate_liberal = yes
					bpm_ig_is_proletarian_socialist = yes
				}
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# very angry IG's more likely to turn to more radical socialism
		if = {
			limit = {
				ig_approval <= -5
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# more likely when issues are relevant
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					bpm_country_laws_have_max_welfare = no
				}
			}
			add = 100
		} 
		else = {
			add = -100
		}
		# more likely for content devout in council republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
				ig_approval >= 0
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
				}
			}
			add = 75
		}
		# more likely for content trade unions outside of council republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				ig_approval >= 0
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
				}
			}
			add = 75
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if the Dreyfusards won.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = dreyfusard_victory
			}
			add = 10
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if you win the Two Spains as the liberals.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = spa_two_spains_liberal_victory
			}
			add = 10
		}
		# Pedro JE victory
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = brz_enduring_empire
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# National Liberation Alliance
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = national_liberation_alliance_variable
					has_journal_entry = je_new_republic
				}
			}
			multiply = 1.20
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_social_democrat_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitator ideologies should disapprove of a current law
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				bpm_country_laws_have_max_welfare = yes
			}
		}
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 50
		interest_group = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						bpm_ig_is_moderate_liberal = yes
						bpm_ig_is_proletarian_socialist = yes
					}
				}
				add = -75
			}
			# very angry IG's more likely to turn to more radical socialism
			if = {
				limit = {
					ig_approval <= -5
				}
				add = -75
			}
		}
		# less likely for moderate liberals and committed socialists
	}
	lawgroup_distribution_of_power = {
		law_weighted_universal_voting = approve	# laws+
		law_proletariat_dictatorship = disapprove	# laws+
		law_ecclesiarchy = disapprove	# derived
	}
}

# ideology_communist
REPLACE:ideology_communist = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_communist.dds"
	
	character_ideology = yes
	show_in_list = yes

	lawgroup_labor_rights = {		
		law_worker_protections = strongly_approve
		law_regulatory_bodies = neutral
		law_no_workers_rights = strongly_disapprove
		law_union_representation = strongly_approve
		law_paradox_employee_benefits = strongly_approve	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_land_reform = {
		law_serfdom = strongly_disapprove
		law_tenant_farmers = disapprove
		law_peasant_proprietorship = neutral
		law_collectivized_agriculture = approve
		law_commercialized_agriculture = disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_governance_principles = {
		law_monarchy = strongly_disapprove
		law_presidential_republic = disapprove
		law_parliamentary_republic = disapprove
		law_theocracy = strongly_disapprove
		law_council_republic = strongly_approve
		law_corporatocracy = strongly_disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_church_and_state = {
		law_state_religion = strongly_disapprove
		law_freedom_of_conscience = neutral
		law_total_separation = approve
		law_state_atheism = strongly_approve
		law_religious_pluralism = neutral
	}

	lawgroup_economic_system = {	
		law_command_economy = strongly_approve
		law_interventionism = neutral
		law_agrarianism = disapprove
		law_traditionalism = strongly_disapprove		
		law_laissez_faire = disapprove		
		law_cooperative_ownership = strongly_approve
		law_industry_banned = strongly_disapprove
		law_extraction_economy = strongly_disapprove
		law_state_capitalism = neutral
		law_class_collaboration = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
		law_early_industrialization = strongly_disapprove	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_labour_associations = {
		law_combination_acts = strongly_disapprove
		law_corporatized_unions = neutral
		law_anti_strike_laws = disapprove
		law_right_to_associate = approve
		law_socialist_labor_unions = approve
		law_syndicalism = neutral
	}

	lawgroup_repeatable_economy = {
		law_repeatable_economy_liberalization = disapprove
		law_repeatable_economy_agricultural_investment = neutral
		law_repeatable_economy_peasant_corvee = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_economy_public_works = approve
		law_repeatable_economy_forced_industrialization = approve
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_communist_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 100
		# Very likely for revsocs after Second Intl
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_revolutionary_socialist = yes
				has_global_variable = second_intl_chain_complete_var
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# More likely for socialists
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_radical_socialist = yes
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_eco_agrarian_socialist
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# Somewhat likely for unions
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
			}
			add = 30
		}
		# More likely for angry IG's outside of council republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
				}
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces }
				ig_approval <= -5
			}
			add = 100
		}
		# More likely when SoL is low outside of council republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
					average_sol <= 10
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# National Liberation Alliance
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = national_liberation_alliance_variable
					has_journal_entry = je_new_republic
				}
			}
			multiply = 1.25
		}
		value = {
			value = 100
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = { has_variable = communism_1_done }
				}
				multiply = 3
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = { has_variable = election_communist_support }
				}
				multiply = 2
			}
		}
		# Syndicalism JE's influence shifts chances
		multiply = {
			if = {
				limit = { 
					owner = { has_variable = bpm_je_syndicalism }
					owner.var:bpm_je_syndicalism >= 33
				}
				add = 66
				subtract = owner.var:bpm_je_syndicalism
				add = 33
				divide = 66
			} else = {
				value = 1
			}
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_communist_valid_trigger = yes 
    	}
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_worker_protections
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_atheism
				bpm_country_laws_has_socialist_economics = yes
			}
		}
		NAND = {
			owner = { NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic } }
			OR = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
				is_heir_of_own_country = yes
				interest_group = { bpm_ig_is_state_institutional = yes }
			}
		}
		owner = { has_technology_researched = socialism }
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		interest_group = {
			value = 100
			# Very likely for revsocs after Second Intl
			if = {
				limit = {
					bpm_ig_is_revolutionary_socialist = yes
					has_global_variable = second_intl_chain_complete_var
				}
				add = 50
			}
			# More likely for socialists
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						bpm_ig_is_radical_socialist = yes
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_eco_agrarian_socialist
					}
				}
				add = 50
			}
			# Somewhat likely for unions
			if = {
				limit = {
					bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
				}
				add = 30
			}
			# More likely for angry IG's outside of council republic
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
					}
					NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces }
					ig_approval <= -5
				}
				add = 100
			}
			# More likely when SoL is low outside of council republic
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
						average_sol <= 10
					}
				}
				add = 50
			}
			# National Liberation Alliance
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						has_variable = national_liberation_alliance_variable
						has_journal_entry = je_new_republic
					}
				}
				multiply = 1.25
			}
			value = {
				value = 100
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = { has_variable = communism_1_done }
					}
					multiply = 3
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = { has_variable = election_communist_support }
					}
					multiply = 2
				}
			}
			# Syndicalism JE's influence shifts chances
			multiply = {
				if = {
					limit = { 
						owner = { has_variable = bpm_je_syndicalism }
						owner.var:bpm_je_syndicalism >= 33
					}
					add = 66
					subtract = owner.var:bpm_je_syndicalism
					add = 33
					divide = 66
				} else = {
					value = 1
				}
			}	
		}
	}
}

# ideology_vanguardist
REPLACE:ideology_vanguardist = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_vanguardist.dds"
	
	character_ideology = yes
	show_in_list = yes

	lawgroup_governance_principles = {
		law_monarchy = strongly_disapprove
		law_presidential_republic = disapprove
		law_parliamentary_republic = disapprove
		law_theocracy = strongly_disapprove
		law_council_republic = strongly_approve
		law_corporatocracy = strongly_disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_land_reform = {
		law_serfdom = strongly_disapprove
		law_tenant_farmers = disapprove
		law_peasant_proprietorship = disapprove
		law_collectivized_agriculture = strongly_approve
		law_commercialized_agriculture = disapprove
	}
	
	lawgroup_free_speech = {
		law_outlawed_dissent = approve
		law_censorship = approve
		law_right_of_assembly = neutral
		law_protected_speech = disapprove
	}

    lawgroup_internal_security = {
		law_no_home_affairs = strongly_disapprove
		law_national_guard = disapprove
		law_secret_police = approve
		law_guaranteed_liberties = neutral
		law_gendarmerie = approve
		law_garde_nationale = disapprove	# derived
	}

    lawgroup_policing = {
		law_no_police = disapprove
		law_local_police = disapprove
		law_dedicated_police = neutral
		law_militarized_police = approve
		law_elected_police = neutral
		law_privatized_police = disapprove	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_economic_system = {	
		law_command_economy = strongly_approve
		law_interventionism = neutral
		law_agrarianism = disapprove
		law_traditionalism = strongly_disapprove		
		law_laissez_faire = disapprove		
		law_cooperative_ownership = neutral
		law_industry_banned = strongly_disapprove
		law_extraction_economy = strongly_disapprove
		law_state_capitalism = neutral
		law_class_collaboration = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
		law_early_industrialization = strongly_disapprove	# derived
	}
	
	lawgroup_trade_policy = {		
		law_protectionism = approve
		law_mercantilism = neutral		
		law_isolationism = disapprove
		law_free_trade = strongly_disapprove
		law_sakoku_shugi = disapprove	# derived
	}				

	lawgroup_labour_associations = {
		law_combination_acts = strongly_disapprove
		law_corporatized_unions = strongly_disapprove
		law_anti_strike_laws = strongly_disapprove
		law_right_to_associate = neutral
		law_socialist_labor_unions = strongly_approve
		law_syndicalism = neutral
	}

	lawgroup_party_laws = {
		law_no_party_bans = disapprove
		law_party_anti_socialist = strongly_disapprove
		law_party_anti_reactionary = neutral
		law_party_reactionary_only = strongly_disapprove
		law_party_socialist_only = approve
		law_party_liberal_only = strongly_disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_repeatable_economy = {
		law_repeatable_economy_liberalization = disapprove
		law_repeatable_economy_agricultural_investment = disapprove
		law_repeatable_economy_peasant_corvee = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_economy_public_works = approve
		law_repeatable_economy_forced_industrialization = strongly_approve
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_vanguardist_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 150
		# More likely for revolutionary socialists
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_revolutionary_socialist = yes
			}
			add = 100
		}
		# More likely when SoL is low outside of council republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_revolutionist_socialists
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
					average_sol <= 10
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# More likely in an autocracy
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_revolutionist_socialists
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_autocracy
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_oligarchy
					}
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# Unlikely for content IG's under anarchism
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_anarchy
				}
				ig_approval >= 5
			}
			add = -100
		}
		# Unlikely for Armed Forces outside of Council Republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
				}
				is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
			}
			add = -100
		}
		# Iminterest_group_leader_trigger for Bureaucrats outside of Council Republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
				}
				is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
			}
			add = -1000
		}
		# Extremely likely for content Armed Forces and Bureaucrats in Council Republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
					is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
				}
				ig_approval >= 0
			}
			add = 1000
		}
		# National Liberation Alliance
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = national_liberation_alliance_variable
					has_journal_entry = je_new_republic
				}
			}
			multiply = 1.25
		}
		# Power corrupts
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
					bpm_country_laws_are_moderately_undemocratic = yes
				}
				is_in_government = yes
			}
			add = 50
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { has_variable = communism_1_done }
			}
			multiply = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { has_variable = election_vanguardist_support }
			}
			multiply = 2
		}
		# Syndicalism JE's influence shifts chances
		multiply = {
			if = {
				limit = { 
					owner = { has_variable = bpm_je_syndicalism }
					owner.var:bpm_je_syndicalism >= 33
				}
				add = 66
				subtract = owner.var:bpm_je_syndicalism
				add = 33
				divide = 66
			} else = {
				value = 1
			}
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_vanguardist_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitator ideologies should disapprove of a current law
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
				AND = {
					bpm_country_laws_has_socialist_economics = yes
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_cooperative_ownership }
				}
				bpm_country_laws_are_very_repressive = yes
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_socialist_labor_unions
			}
		}
		# State forces outside of CR should not be communist
		NAND = {
			owner = { NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic } }
			OR = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
				is_heir_of_own_country = yes
				interest_group = { bpm_ig_is_state_institutional = yes }
			}
		}
		owner = { has_technology_researched = socialism }
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 150
		interest_group = {
			if = {
    			limit = {
    				owner = {
    					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
    				}
    				is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
    			}
    			add = -1000
    		}
    		# Extremely likely for content Armed Forces and Bureaucrats in Council Republic
    		if = {
    			limit = {
    				owner = {
    					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
    				}
    				OR = {
    					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
    					is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
    				}
    				ig_approval >= 0
    			}
    			add = 1000
    		}
    		# National Liberation Alliance
    		if = {
    			limit = {
    				owner = {
    					has_variable = national_liberation_alliance_variable
    					has_journal_entry = je_new_republic
    				}
    			}
    			multiply = 1.25
    		}
    		# Power corrupts
    		if = {
    			limit = {
    				owner = {
    					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
    					bpm_country_laws_are_moderately_undemocratic = yes
    				}
    				is_in_government = yes
    			}
    			add = 50
    		}
    		if = {
    			limit = {
    				owner = { has_variable = communism_1_done }
    			}
    			multiply = 3
    		}
    		if = {
    			limit = {
    				owner = { has_variable = election_vanguardist_support }
    			}
    			multiply = 2
    		}
    		# Syndicalism JE's influence shifts chances
    		multiply = {
    			if = {
    				limit = { 
    					owner = { has_variable = bpm_je_syndicalism }
    					owner.var:bpm_je_syndicalism >= 33
    				}
    				add = 66
    				subtract = owner.var:bpm_je_syndicalism
    				add = 33
    				divide = 66
    			} else = {
    				value = 1
    			}
    		}
		}
		# More likely for revolutionary socialists
	}
	lawgroup_distribution_of_power = {
		law_weighted_universal_voting = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
		law_proletariat_dictatorship = approve	# laws+
		law_ecclesiarchy = approve	# derived
	}
	lawgroup_ballot_system = {
		law_no_election = approve	# laws+
		law_semi_constitutional = disapprove	# laws+
		law_non_secret_ballot = neutral	# laws+
		law_secret_ballot = disapprove	# laws+
		law_direct_democracy = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
	}
}

		law_repeatable_culture_promote_ultranationalist_values = strongly_approve
