	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_fascist_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = -200
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_fascist = yes
			}
			add = 200
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_traditionalist = yes
			}
			add = 100
		}
		# More likely if paying war reparations
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = {
					any_scope_treaty = {
						is_enforced = yes
						any_scope_article = {
							has_type = money_transfer
							source_country = root.owner
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# More likely with a convenient scapegoat
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_scope_state = {
						is_incorporated = yes
						any_scope_pop = {
							pop_acceptance < 40
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# more likely if bankrupt
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					in_default = yes
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# Less likely in council republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
				}
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# more likely if angry non-unions
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_ethnostate }
				}
				ig_approval <= -5
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions }
			}
			add = 75
		}
		# less likely if content without ethnostate
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_ethnostate
					}
				}
				ig_approval <= 5
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# more likely for PB and armed forces
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_state_institutional = yes
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# less likely for unions
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_labor = yes
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# more likely if in government with ethnostate
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_ethnostate
					NOR = {
						is_enacting_law = law_type:law_multicultural
						is_enacting_law = law_type:law_national_supremacy
						is_enacting_law = law_type:law_racial_segregation
						is_enacting_law = law_type:law_cultural_exclusion
					}
				}
				is_in_government = yes
			}
			add = 150
		}
		# conservative and/or reactionary leaders have a higher spawn chance if the Anti-Dreyfusards won.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = anti_dreyfusard_victory
			}
			add = 10
		}
		# conservative and/or reactionary leaders have a higher spawn chance if you win the Two Spains as the conservatives.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = spa_two_spains_conservative_victory
			}
			add = 10
		}
		# red scare can make you more fascist
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = fascist_uptick
			}
			add = 25
		}
		if = { #Brazil has Integralists instead
			limit = {
				owner = {
					c:BRZ ?= this
				}
			}
			multiply = 0
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_fascist_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitator ideologies should disapprove of a current law
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				bpm_country_laws_are_very_undemocratic = yes
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_ethnostate
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_militarized_police
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_mass_conscription
			}
		}
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = -200
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_fascist = yes
			}
			add = 200
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_traditionalist = yes
			}
			add = 100
		}
		# More likely if paying war reparations
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = {
					any_scope_treaty = {
						is_enforced = yes
						any_scope_article = {
							has_type = money_transfer
							source_country = root.owner
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# More likely with a convenient scapegoat
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_scope_state = {
						is_incorporated = yes
						any_scope_pop = {
							pop_acceptance < 40
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# more likely if bankrupt
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					in_default = yes
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# Less likely in council republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
				}
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# more likely if angry non-unions
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_ethnostate }
				}
				interest_group.ig_approval <= -5
				interest_group = { NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions } }
			}
			add = 75
		}
		# less likely if content without ethnostate
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_ethnostate
					}
				}
				interest_group.ig_approval <= 5
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# more likely for PB and armed forces
		if = {
			limit = {
				interest_group = {
					bpm_ig_is_state_institutional = yes
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# less likely for unions
		if = {
			limit = {
				interest_group = {
					bpm_ig_is_labor = yes
				}
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# more likely if in government with ethnostate
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_ethnostate
					NOR = {
						is_enacting_law = law_type:law_multicultural
						is_enacting_law = law_type:law_national_supremacy
						is_enacting_law = law_type:law_racial_segregation
						is_enacting_law = law_type:law_cultural_exclusion
					}
				}
				interest_group = {is_in_government = yes}
			}
			add = 150
		}
		# conservative and/or reactionary leaders have a higher spawn chance if the Anti-Dreyfusards won.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = anti_dreyfusard_victory
			}
			add = 10
		}
		# conservative and/or reactionary leaders have a higher spawn chance if you win the Two Spains as the conservatives.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = spa_two_spains_conservative_victory
			}
			add = 10
		}
		# red scare can make you more fascist
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = fascist_uptick
			}
			add = 25
		}
		if = { #Brazil has Integralists instead
			limit = {
				owner = {
					c:BRZ ?= this
				}
			}
			multiply = 0
		}
	}
	lawgroup_discriminated_pop = {
		law_no_codified_discrimination = strongly_disapprove
		law_racial_hierarchy = approve	# laws+
		law_violent_suppresion = approve	# laws+
	}
	lawgroup_internal_security = {
		law_gendarmerie = approve	# laws+
		law_garde_nationale = approve	# derived
	}
	lawgroup_ballot_system = {
		law_direct_democracy = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_no_election = approve	# derived
		law_non_secret_ballot = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_secret_ballot = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_semi_constitutional = strongly_disapprove	# derived
	}
}

# ideology_anarchist
REPLACE:ideology_anarchist = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_anarchist.dds"
	
	character_ideology = yes
	show_in_list = yes

	lawgroup_citizenship = {
		law_ethnostate = strongly_disapprove
		law_national_supremacy = strongly_disapprove
		law_racial_segregation = strongly_disapprove
		law_cultural_exclusion = disapprove
		law_multicultural = strongly_approve
		law_subjecthood = strongly_disapprove
		law_cosmopolitanism = strongly_approve	# derived
		law_hellenoturkism = disapprove	# derived
	}	

	lawgroup_distribution_of_power = {
		law_anarchy = strongly_approve
		law_universal_suffrage = neutral
		law_census_voting = disapprove
		law_wealth_voting = strongly_disapprove	
		law_landed_voting = strongly_disapprove	
		law_oligarchy = strongly_disapprove
		law_autocracy = strongly_disapprove		
		law_technocracy = strongly_disapprove
		law_military_junta = strongly_disapprove
		law_organic_democracy = strongly_disapprove
		law_ecclesiarchy = strongly_disapprove
		law_proletariat_dictatorship = approve
		law_weighted_universal_voting = disapprove	# laws+
	}

	lawgroup_economic_system = {	
		law_command_economy = disapprove
		law_interventionism = disapprove
		law_agrarianism = disapprove
		law_traditionalism = strongly_disapprove		
		law_laissez_faire = disapprove		
		law_cooperative_ownership = strongly_approve
		law_industry_banned = strongly_disapprove
		law_extraction_economy = strongly_disapprove
		law_state_capitalism = disapprove
		law_class_collaboration = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
		law_early_industrialization = strongly_disapprove	# derived
	}
	lawgroup_army_model = { 
		law_professional_army = disapprove
		law_national_militia = neutral
		law_peasant_levies = disapprove
		law_mass_conscription = strongly_disapprove
		law_amabutho = disapprove	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_navy_model = {
		law_merchant_navy = approve
		law_jeune_ecole = strongly_disapprove
		law_professional_navy = strongly_disapprove
		law_diplomatic_navy = disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_free_speech = {
		law_protected_speech = strongly_approve
		law_right_of_assembly = approve
		law_censorship = disapprove
		law_outlawed_dissent = strongly_disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_policing = {
		law_no_police = approve
		law_local_police = disapprove
		law_dedicated_police = disapprove
		law_militarized_police = strongly_disapprove
		law_elected_police = strongly_approve
		law_privatized_police = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
	}

	lawgroup_governance_principles = {
		law_monarchy = strongly_disapprove
		law_presidential_republic = disapprove
		law_parliamentary_republic = disapprove
		law_theocracy = strongly_disapprove
		law_council_republic = strongly_approve
		law_corporatocracy = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
	}

	lawgroup_land_reform = {
		law_serfdom = strongly_disapprove
		law_tenant_farmers = strongly_disapprove
		law_peasant_proprietorship = approve
		law_collectivized_agriculture = approve
		law_commercialized_agriculture = disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_labour_associations = {
		law_combination_acts = strongly_disapprove
		law_corporatized_unions = strongly_disapprove
		law_anti_strike_laws = strongly_disapprove
		law_right_to_associate = approve
		law_socialist_labor_unions = disapprove
		law_syndicalism = neutral
	}

	lawgroup_repeatable_economy = {
		law_repeatable_economy_liberalization = disapprove
		law_repeatable_economy_agricultural_investment = neutral
		law_repeatable_economy_peasant_corvee = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_economy_public_works = approve
		law_repeatable_economy_forced_industrialization = disapprove
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_anarchist_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = -40
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_anarchists
			}
			add = 400
		}
		# More likely for angry IG's outside of council republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
					has_variable = local_anarchists_split_var
				}
				ig_approval <= -10
				bpm_ig_is_revolutionary_socialist = no
			}
			add = 30
		}
		# More likely for agrarian populists when serfdom is legal
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_agrarian_populists
				}
			}
			add = 70
		}
		# More likely if under anarchy
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_anarchy
				}
			}
			add = 110
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { has_variable = communism_1_done }
			}
			multiply = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { has_variable = election_anarchist_support }
			}
			multiply = 10
		}
		# National Liberation Alliance
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = national_liberation_alliance_variable
					has_journal_entry = je_new_republic
				}
			}
			multiply = 1.10
		}
		# Syndicalism JE's influence shifts chances
		multiply = {
			if = {
				limit = { 
					owner = { has_variable = bpm_je_syndicalism }
					owner.var:bpm_je_syndicalism >= 33
				}
				add = 66
				subtract = owner.var:bpm_je_syndicalism
				add = 33
				divide = 66
			} else = {
				value = 1
			}
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_anarchist_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitator ideologies should disapprove of a current law
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_anarchy
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_protected_speech
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_elected_police
				AND = {
					bpm_country_laws_has_socialist_economics = yes
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_command_economy }
				}
			}
		}
		# Monarchs cannot be republicans
		NAND = {
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
			}
			OR = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
				is_heir_of_own_country = yes
			}
		}
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 10
	}
	lawgroup_discriminated_pop = {
		law_no_codified_discrimination = strongly_approve
		law_racial_hierarchy = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
		law_violent_suppresion = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
	}
	lawgroup_ballot_system = {
		law_semi_constitutional = disapprove	# laws+
		law_non_secret_ballot = disapprove	# laws+
		law_secret_ballot = disapprove	# laws+
		law_direct_democracy = approve	# laws+
		law_no_election = strongly_disapprove	# derived
	}
}

					owner = { has_variable = bpm_je_syndicalism }
					owner.var:bpm_je_syndicalism >= 33
				}
				add = owner.var:bpm_je_syndicalism
				subtract = 33
				divide = 66
			}
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
			ideology_anarchist_syndicalist_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitator ideologies should disapprove of a current law

			owner = {

# ideology_agrarian_socialist_leader
REPLACE:ideology_agrarian_socialist_leader = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_Agrarian.dds"
	
	character_ideology = yes
	show_in_list = yes

	lawgroup_distribution_of_power = {
		law_anarchy = approve
		law_universal_suffrage = strongly_approve
		law_census_voting = disapprove
		law_wealth_voting = strongly_disapprove	
		law_landed_voting = strongly_disapprove	
		law_oligarchy = strongly_disapprove
		law_autocracy = strongly_disapprove		
		law_technocracy = disapprove
		law_military_junta = disapprove
		law_organic_democracy = strongly_disapprove
		law_proletariat_dictatorship = neutral
		law_ecclesiarchy = strongly_disapprove
		law_weighted_universal_voting = neutral	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_land_reform = {
		law_serfdom = strongly_disapprove
		law_tenant_farmers = strongly_disapprove
		law_peasant_proprietorship = approve
		law_collectivized_agriculture = strongly_approve
		law_commercialized_agriculture = disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_army_model = { 
		law_professional_army = strongly_disapprove
		law_national_militia = neutral
		law_peasant_levies = strongly_disapprove
		law_mass_conscription = strongly_disapprove
		law_amabutho = strongly_disapprove	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_navy_model = {
		law_merchant_navy = approve
		law_jeune_ecole = disapprove
		law_professional_navy = strongly_disapprove
		law_diplomatic_navy = disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_policing = {
		law_no_police = approve
		law_local_police = disapprove
		law_dedicated_police = disapprove
		law_militarized_police = strongly_disapprove
		law_elected_police = approve
		law_privatized_police = approve	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_economic_system = {	
		law_command_economy = strongly_disapprove
		law_interventionism = disapprove
		law_agrarianism = approve
		law_traditionalism = strongly_disapprove		
		law_laissez_faire = disapprove		
		law_cooperative_ownership = strongly_approve
		law_industry_banned = approve
		law_extraction_economy = strongly_disapprove
		law_state_capitalism = disapprove
		law_class_collaboration = neutral	# derived
		law_early_industrialization = disapprove	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_repeatable_economy = {
		law_repeatable_economy_liberalization = disapprove
		law_repeatable_economy_agricultural_investment = strongly_approve
		law_repeatable_economy_peasant_corvee = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_economy_public_works = neutral
		law_repeatable_economy_forced_industrialization = strongly_disapprove
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_agrarian_socialist_leader_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 10
		# More likely for agrarian populists and anarchists
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
				}
				is_interest_group_type = ig_agrarian_populists
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# More likely for agrarian populists and anarchists when serfdom is legal
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
				}
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_anarchist = yes
					is_interest_group_type = ig_agrarian_populists
				}
			}
			add = 75
		}
		# More likely for rural folk when agrarian populists are socialist
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					ig:ig_agrarian_populists ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_agrarian_socialist_leader
					}
				}
				is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk
			}
			add = 100
		}
		# More likely for rural folk in CR
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_anarchy
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
					}
				}
				is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk
			}
			add = 75
		}
		# Higher chance if Agrarian Socialism is popular
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = bpm_agrarian_socialism_power
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = bpm_agrarian_socialism_power_global }
					global_var:bpm_agrarian_socialism_power_global <= var:bpm_agrarian_socialism_power
				}
			}
			add = var:bpm_agrarian_socialism_power
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = bpm_agrarian_socialism_power_global
			}
			add = global_var:bpm_agrarian_socialism_power_global
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_agrarian_socialist_leader_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitator ideologies should disapprove of a current law
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				OR = { 
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_collectivized_agriculture
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_peasant_proprietorship
				}
				OR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_agrarianism
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_cooperative_ownership
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_industry_banned
				}
				OR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_anarchy
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
				}
			}
		}
		# Monarchs cannot be republicans
		NAND = {
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
			}
			OR = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
				is_heir_of_own_country = yes
			}
		}
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 10
	}
	lawgroup_ballot_system = {
		law_direct_democracy = strongly_approve	# derived
		law_no_election = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_non_secret_ballot = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_secret_ballot = strongly_approve	# derived
		law_semi_constitutional = strongly_disapprove	# derived
	}
}

# ideology_ethno_nationalist
REPLACE:ideology_ethno_nationalist = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_ethno_nationalist.dds" 
	
	character_ideology = yes
	show_in_list = yes

	lawgroup_citizenship = {
		law_ethnostate = strongly_approve
		law_national_supremacy = approve
		law_racial_segregation = approve
		law_cultural_exclusion = disapprove
		law_multicultural = strongly_disapprove	
		law_subjecthood = neutral
		law_cosmopolitanism = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_hellenoturkism = disapprove	# derived
	}
	
	lawgroup_migration = {
		law_migration_controls = strongly_approve
		law_closed_borders = approve
		law_no_migration_controls = disapprove	
	}

	lawgroup_repeatable_culture = {
		law_repeatable_culture_invite_foreign_experts = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_democratic_values = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_culture_affirmative_action = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_socialist_values = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_patriotic_values = strongly_approve
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_absolutist_values = approve
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_ultranationalist_values = strongly_approve
	}

	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_ethno_nationalist_valid_trigger = yes
		
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 25
		# More likely with unowned claims
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_state = {
					has_claim_by = root.owner
				}
			}
			add = 75
		}
		# More likely with a convenient scapegoat
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_scope_state = {
						is_incorporated = yes
						any_scope_pop = {
							pop_acceptance < 40
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# More likely with a convenient scapegoat and is angry without ethnostate
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_ethnostate }
					any_scope_state = {
						is_incorporated = yes
						any_scope_pop = {
							pop_acceptance < 40
						}
					}
				}
				ig_approval <= -5
			}
			add = 75
		}
		# More likely if angry and issues are relevant
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_ethnostate
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_national_supremacy
					}
				}
				ig_approval <= -5
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# Less likely in council republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
				}
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# less likely if content without ethnostate
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_ethnostate
					}
				}
				ig_approval <= 5
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# conservative and/or reactionary leaders have a higher spawn chance if the Anti-Dreyfusards won.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = anti_dreyfusard_victory
			}
			add = 10
		}
		# conservative and/or reactionary leaders have a higher spawn chance if you win the Two Spains as the conservatives.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = spa_two_spains_conservative_victory
			}
			add = 10
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_ethno_nationalist_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitator ideologies should disapprove of a current law
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_ethnostate
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_migration_controls
			}
		}
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 100
	}
	lawgroup_discriminated_pop = {
		law_no_codified_discrimination = strongly_disapprove
		law_racial_hierarchy = approve	# laws+
		law_violent_suppresion = neutral	# laws+
	}
}

# ideology_theocrat
REPLACE:ideology_theocrat = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_theocrat.dds"
	
	character_ideology = yes
	show_in_list = yes
	lawgroup_church_and_state = {
		law_state_religion = approve
		law_freedom_of_conscience = disapprove
		law_total_separation = strongly_disapprove
		law_state_atheism = strongly_disapprove
		law_religious_pluralism = disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_governance_principles = {
		law_theocracy = strongly_approve	
		law_monarchy = neutral
		law_presidential_republic = disapprove
		law_parliamentary_republic = disapprove
		law_council_republic = disapprove
		law_corporatocracy = strongly_disapprove
	}
	
	lawgroup_repeatable_religion = {
		law_repeatable_religion_promote_state_religion = approve
		law_repeatable_religion_anti_secular_reaction = strongly_approve
		law_repeatable_religion_promote_secular_values = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_religion_anti_religious_violence = strongly_disapprove
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_theocrat_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 50
		# more likely if devout and angry and issues are relevant
		if = {
			limit = {
				ig_approval <= -5
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
					is_interest_group_type = ig_reactionaries
				}
				owner = {
					bpm_country_is_republic = yes
					NOT = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_religion
					}
				}
			}
			add = 75
		}
		# More likely for devout
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# Unlikely for content IG's when issues aren't relevant
		if = {
			limit = {
				ig_approval >= 5
				owner = {
					bpm_country_is_republic = yes
					NOT = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_religion
					}
				}
			}
			add = -150
		}
		# conservative and/or reactionary leaders have a higher spawn chance if the Anti-Dreyfusards won.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = anti_dreyfusard_victory
			}
			add = 10
		}

		# conservative and/or reactionary leaders have a higher spawn chance if you win the Two Spains as the conservatives.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = spa_two_spains_conservative_victory
			}
			add = 10
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
			ideology_theocrat_valid_trigger = yes
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					owner = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_atheism
					}
				}
			}
			religion ?= ROOT.owner.religion
		}

		# Agitator ideologies should disapprove of a current law
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				bpm_country_laws_are_moralist = yes
			}
		}
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 50
		# more likely if devout and angry and issues are relevant
	}
	lawgroup_distribution_of_power = {
		law_ecclesiarchy = strongly_approve
		law_proletariat_dictatorship = strongly_disapprove
		law_weighted_universal_voting = strongly_disapprove	# derived
	}
}

# ideology_market_liberal
REPLACE:ideology_market_liberal = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_market_liberal.dds"
	
	character_ideology = yes
	show_in_list = yes
	lawgroup_economic_system = {	
		law_laissez_faire = strongly_approve
		law_interventionism = neutral
		law_agrarianism = disapprove
		law_traditionalism = disapprove		
		law_command_economy = strongly_disapprove
		law_cooperative_ownership = disapprove
		law_industry_banned = strongly_disapprove
		law_extraction_economy = strongly_disapprove
		law_state_capitalism = disapprove
		law_class_collaboration = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
		law_early_industrialization = strongly_disapprove	# derived
	}
	
	lawgroup_childrens_rights = {
		law_child_labor_allowed = approve
		law_restricted_child_labor = approve
		law_compulsory_primary_school = neutral
		law_child_benefit = neutral
	}	
	
	lawgroup_trade_policy = {
		law_free_trade = strongly_approve
		law_mercantilism = disapprove
		law_protectionism = disapprove		
		law_isolationism = strongly_disapprove
		law_sakoku_shugi = strongly_disapprove	# derived
	}			

	lawgroup_labor_rights = {
		law_no_workers_rights = approve
		law_regulatory_bodies = disapprove
		law_worker_protections = strongly_disapprove
		law_union_representation = strongly_disapprove
		law_paradox_employee_benefits = strongly_disapprove	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_land_reform = {
		law_collectivized_agriculture = strongly_disapprove
		law_serfdom = strongly_disapprove
		law_tenant_farmers = disapprove
		law_peasant_proprietorship = neutral
		law_commercialized_agriculture = approve
	}

	lawgroup_repeatable_economy = {
		law_repeatable_economy_liberalization = strongly_approve
		law_repeatable_economy_agricultural_investment = neutral
		law_repeatable_economy_peasant_corvee = disapprove
		law_repeatable_economy_public_works = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_economy_forced_industrialization = strongly_disapprove
	}

	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_market_liberal_valid_trigger = yes
	}

	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 25
		# more likely for industrialists
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# more likely for liberals
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_moderate_liberal = yes
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# more likely for market liberals
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_market_liberals
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# more likely for intelligentsia, industrialists with traditional economic laws
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
					is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
				}
				owner = {
					bpm_country_laws_have_traditional_economics = yes
				}
			}
			add = 75
		}
		# more likely for weaker landowers when industrialists are powerful
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
				is_powerful = no
				owner = {
					ig:ig_industrialists = {
						is_powerful = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 75
		}
		# less likely for non-urban IGs
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_institutional = yes
				bpm_ig_is_urban_institutional = no
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# less likely for landowners under traditional laws
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
					bpm_ig_is_right_wing = yes
				}
				owner = {
					bpm_country_laws_have_traditional_economics = yes
				}
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# very unlikely in countries without a large urban center
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						any_scope_state = {
							any_scope_building = {
								is_building_type = building_urban_center
								level >= 10
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = -150
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_market_liberal_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitator ideologies should disapprove of a current law
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				bpm_country_laws_are_very_capitalist = yes
			}
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 25
	}
}

		law_state_capitalism = disapprove

	}

		law_free_trade = strongly_disapprove
		law_mercantilism = neutral
		law_protectionism = approve		
		law_isolationism = strongly_approve
		law_sakoku_shugi = strongly_approve	# derived
	}

		law_repeatable_economy_liberalization = disapprove
		law_repeatable_economy_agricultural_investment = strongly_approve
		law_repeatable_economy_peasant_corvee = disapprove
		law_repeatable_economy_public_works = disapprove
		law_repeatable_economy_forced_industrialization = strongly_disapprove
	}

	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_luddite_valid_trigger = yes
	}

	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 0 # this is not very likely
		# More likely to support with some industry
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_scope_building = {
						is_building_group = bg_heavy_industry
						level >= 5
					}
				}
			}
			add = 40
		}
		# LESS likely to support with lots of industry
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_scope_building = {
						is_building_group = bg_heavy_industry
						level >= 10
					}
				}
			}
			add = -40
		}
		# More likely for unrecognized countries
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_country_type = unrecognized
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# less likely for GPs
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					country_rank = rank_value:great_power
				}
			}
			add = -50
		}
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_luddite_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitator ideologies should disapprove of a current law
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_isolationism
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_industry_banned
			}
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 0 # this is not very likely
	}
}

				owner = { 
					bpm_country_laws_are_very_undemocratic = yes
				}
			}
			add = -50
		}
		# less likely if not in government

			limit = {
				is_in_government = no
			}
			add = -50
		}
		# less likely for progressive IG's

			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_traditionalist = yes
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# less likely for IGs happy under democracy
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						bpm_country_laws_are_very_undemocratic = yes
						bpm_country_laws_are_moderately_undemocratic = yes
					}
				}
				ig_approval > 0
			}
			add = -25
		}
		# less likely for conservative French IG's
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					exists = c:FRA
					this = c:FRA
					has_journal_entry = je_divided_monarchists
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
					is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
					is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
				}
			}
			add = -100
		}
		# conservative and/or reactionary leaders have a higher spawn chance if the Anti-Dreyfusards won.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = anti_dreyfusard_victory
			}
			add = 10
		}

		# conservative and/or reactionary leaders have a higher spawn chance if you win the Two Spains as the conservatives.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = spa_two_spains_conservative_victory
			}
			add = 10
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_authoritarian_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitator ideologies should disapprove of a current law
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				bpm_country_laws_are_very_undemocratic = yes
			}
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 50
	}
	lawgroup_ballot_system = {
		law_no_election = approve	# laws+
		law_semi_constitutional = approve	# laws+
		law_non_secret_ballot = neutral	# laws+
		law_secret_ballot = disapprove	# laws+
		law_direct_democracy = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
	}
}

			}
			add = -50
		}
		# More likely for unrecognized countries
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_country_type = unrecognized
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# less likely for GP's
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					country_rank = rank_value:great_power
				}
			}
			add = -25
		}
		# less likely for conservative French IG's
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					exists = c:FRA
					this = c:FRA
					has_journal_entry = je_divided_monarchists
				}

				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
					is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
				}
			}
			add = -100
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_protectionist_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitator ideologies should disapprove of a current law
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				bpm_country_laws_are_protectionist = yes
			}
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 50
	}
}

			}

			add = 75
		}

					has_variable = positivist_leaders_large_increase_var

				}
			}
			add = 250
		}

			value = 0.5
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = { has_technology_researched = shift_work }
				}
				value = 1.0
			}
		}
	}

        interest_group = {
    		ideology_positivist_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitators should have an ideology at odds with current laws
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_appointed_bureaucrats
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_technocracy
				OR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_atheism
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_total_separation
				}
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_presidential_republic
			}
		}
		# Monarchs cannot be republicans
		NAND = {
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
			}
			OR = {
				is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
				is_heir_of_own_country = yes
			}
		}
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 10
	}
	lawgroup_ballot_system = {
		law_direct_democracy = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_no_election = neutral	# derived
		law_non_secret_ballot = approve	# derived
		law_secret_ballot = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_semi_constitutional = disapprove	# derived
	}
}

# ideology_land_reformer
REPLACE:ideology_land_reformer = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_land_reformer.dds"
	
	character_ideology = yes
	show_in_list = yes
	lawgroup_centralization = {
		law_unitary = neutral
		law_devolved = neutral
		law_federated = neutral
		law_confederated = neutral
		law_ad_hoc_centralization = strongly_disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_taxation = {
		law_land_based_taxation = strongly_disapprove
		law_consumption_based_taxation = neutral
		law_per_capita_based_taxation = neutral
		law_proportional_taxation = neutral
		law_graduated_taxation = neutral
		law_no_income_tax = neutral	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_land_reform = {
		law_serfdom = strongly_disapprove
		law_tenant_farmers = neutral
		law_commercialized_agriculture = neutral
		law_peasant_proprietorship = approve
		law_collectivized_agriculture = neutral
	}

	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_land_reformer_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 25
		# less likely for urbanites
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_urban_institutional = yes
					bpm_ig_is_state_institutional = yes
				}
			}
			add = -100
		}
		# less likely for right wingers
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_right_wing = yes
			}
			add = -100
		}
		# more likely when issues are relevant
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_land_based_taxation
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_ad_hoc_centralization
					}
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# more likely for displeased peasants
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk
				ig_approval <= 0
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_tenant_farmers
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_land_based_taxation
					}
				}
			}
			add = 150
		}
		# likely to emerge if landowners are powerful
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					exists = ig:ig_landowners
					ig:ig_landowners = {
						is_powerful = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# likely to emerge if agrarian
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_traditionalism
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_agrarianism
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_industry_banned
					}
				}
			}
			add = 100
		}
		# will not happen if land reform is essentially done
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_land_based_taxation
					}
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_peasant_proprietorship
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_collectivized_agriculture
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 0.01
		}
		# Pedro JE victory
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = brz_enduring_empire
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_land_reformer_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitator ideologies should disapprove of a current law
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				NOR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_land_based_taxation
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_ad_hoc_centralization
				}
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_peasant_proprietorship
			}
		}
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 25
	}
}

# ideology_integralist

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_integralist.dds"
	
	character_ideology = yes

		law_total_separation = strongly_disapprove
		law_state_atheism = strongly_disapprove
		law_religious_pluralism = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
	}

		law_cultural_exclusion = approve
		law_racial_segregation = neutral
		law_multicultural = disapprove	
		law_ethnostate = disapprove
		law_national_supremacy = disapprove
		law_subjecthood = disapprove
		law_cosmopolitanism = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_hellenoturkism = approve	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_distribution_of_power = {
		law_autocracy = approve
		law_oligarchy = approve
		law_landed_voting = neutral
		law_wealth_voting = disapprove
		law_technocracy = strongly_disapprove
		law_census_voting = strongly_disapprove
		law_universal_suffrage = strongly_disapprove
		law_anarchy = strongly_disapprove
		law_military_junta = approve
		law_organic_democracy = strongly_approve
		law_proletariat_dictatorship = strongly_disapprove
		law_ecclesiarchy = approve
		law_weighted_universal_voting = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
	}

	lawgroup_centralization = {
		law_unitary = strongly_disapprove
		law_devolved = disapprove
		law_federated = approve
		law_confederated = strongly_approve
		law_ad_hoc_centralization = neutral
	}

	lawgroup_repeatable_religion = {
		law_repeatable_religion_promote_state_religion = approve
		law_repeatable_religion_anti_secular_reaction = strongly_approve
		law_repeatable_religion_promote_secular_values = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_religion_anti_religious_violence = strongly_disapprove
	}

	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_integralist_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_fascist = yes
			}
			add = 200
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_traditionalist = yes
			}
			add = 100
		}
		# More likely if paying war reparations
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = {
					any_scope_treaty = {
						is_enforced = yes
						any_scope_article = {
							has_type = money_transfer
							source_country = root.owner
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# more likely if bankrupt
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					in_default = yes
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# Less likely in council republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
				}
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# more likely if angry non-unions
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { 
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_autocracy
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_religion
					}
				}
				ig_approval <= -5
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions }
			}
			add = 75
		}
		# less likely if content without integralist laws
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_autocracy
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_religion
					}
				}
				ig_approval >= 5
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# more likely for PB, Devout, and armed forces
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_middle_institutional = yes
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# less likely for unions and intelligentsia
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_left_wing = yes
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# France has non-Integralist fascists
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_primary_culture = {
						has_discrimination_trait = language_francophone
					}
				}
				bpm_ig_is_fascist = yes
			}
			add = -150
		}
		# France also has non-Integralist traditionalists
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_traditionalist = yes
			}
			add = -50
		}
		# conservative and/or reactionary leaders have a higher spawn chance if the Anti-Dreyfusards won.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = anti_dreyfusard_victory
			}
			add = 10
		}

		# conservative and/or reactionary leaders have a higher spawn chance if you win the Two Spains as the conservatives.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = spa_two_spains_conservative_victory
			}
			add = 10
		}
		# Vargas fosters fascism
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_journal_entry = je_new_republic
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# red scare can make you more fascist
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = fascist_uptick
			}
			add = 25
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_integralist_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitator ideologies should disapprove of a current law
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_autocracy
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_cultural_exclusion
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_religion
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_militarized_police
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_confederated
			}
		}
		# Any Interest Group
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 0
	}
	lawgroup_internal_security = {
		law_gendarmerie = approve	# laws+
		law_garde_nationale = approve	# derived
	}
	lawgroup_governance_principles = {
		law_corporatocracy = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
	}
	lawgroup_ballot_system = {
		law_semi_constitutional = approve	# laws+
		law_non_secret_ballot = neutral	# laws+
		law_secret_ballot = disapprove	# laws+
		law_direct_democracy = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
		law_no_election = approve	# derived
	}
	lawgroup_discriminated_pop = {
		law_no_codified_discrimination = disapprove	# derived
		law_racial_hierarchy = neutral	# derived
		law_violent_suppresion = strongly_disapprove	# derived

		law_repeatable_culture_promote_socialist_values = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_patriotic_values = approve
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_absolutist_values = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_ultranationalist_values = strongly_disapprove
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_liberal_leader_valid_trigger = yes
	}

		value = 25
		# less likely if rural
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_rural_institutional = yes
			}
			add = -50
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_census_voting
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_wealth_voting
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_landed_voting
					}
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_elected_bureaucrats
				}
			}
			add = -25
		}
		# IGs will not sabotage their own dictatorships
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_autocracy
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_oligarchy
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_technocracy
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_military_junta
					}
					OR = {
						any_scope_character = {
							is_ruler_of_own_country = yes
							this.interest_group = root
						}
						root = {
							OR = {
								is_in_government = yes
								bpm_ig_is_state_institutional = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# More common in republics
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					bpm_country_is_bourgeois_republic = yes
				}
			}
			add = 25
		}
		else = {
			add = -50
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if the Dreyfusards won.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = dreyfusard_victory
			}
			add = 25
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if you win the Two Spains as the liberals.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = spa_two_spains_liberal_victory
			}
			add = 25
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_liberal_leader_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitators should have an ideology at odds with current laws
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				bpm_country_laws_ok_voting = yes
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_elected_bureaucrats
			}
		}
	}

		value = 25
	}

	character_ideology = yes
	show_in_list = yes
	lawgroup_governance_principles = {
		law_monarchy = strongly_approve
		law_presidential_republic = disapprove
		law_parliamentary_republic = disapprove
		law_theocracy = disapprove

		law_women_own_property = disapprove
		law_women_in_the_workplace = neutral
		law_womens_suffrage = disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_childrens_rights = {
		law_child_labor_allowed = strongly_disapprove
		law_restricted_child_labor = disapprove
		law_compulsory_primary_school = approve
		law_child_benefit = strongly_approve
	}

	lawgroup_repeatable_culture = {
		law_repeatable_culture_invite_foreign_experts = strongly_approve
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_democratic_values = approve
		law_repeatable_culture_affirmative_action = disapprove
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_socialist_values = disapprove
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_patriotic_values = approve
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_absolutist_values = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_culture_promote_ultranationalist_values = strongly_disapprove
	}


	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_humanitarian_royalist_valid_trigger = yes
	}

	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 50
		# more likely for conservatives/liberals
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_liberals
					bpm_ig_is_liberal_conservative = yes
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# less likely if issues are not relevant
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_multicultural
				}
			}
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_protected_speech
				}
			}
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_womens_suffrage
				}
			}
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_compulsory_primary_school
				}
			}
			add = -25
		}
		# more likely if issues are relevant
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_ethnostate
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_national_supremacy
					}
				}
			}
			add = 25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_national_guard
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_secret_police
					}
				}
			}
			add = 25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_censorship
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					}
				}
			}
			add = 25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_womens_rights
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_women_own_property
					}
				}
			}
			add = 25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_restricted_child_labor
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_child_labor_allowed #PBF
					}
				}
			}
			add = 25
		}
		# less likely for angry trade unions, they should go communist instead
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_technology_researched = socialism
				}
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				ig_approval < 5
			}
			add = -100
		}
		# Pedro JE victory
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = brz_enduring_empire
				}
			}
			add = 100
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if the Dreyfusards won.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = dreyfusard_victory
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if you win the Two Spains as the liberals.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = spa_two_spains_liberal_victory
			}
			add = 50
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_humanitarian_royalist_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
				NOT = { bpm_country_laws_are_racist = yes }
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_guaranteed_liberties
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_womens_suffrage
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_compulsory_primary_school
			}
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 100
	}
	lawgroup_discriminated_pop = {
		law_no_codified_discrimination = strongly_approve

REPLACE:ideology_orleanist = {

	show_in_list = yes
	lawgroup_governance_principles = {
		law_monarchy = strongly_approve
		law_presidential_republic = neutral
		law_parliamentary_republic = disapprove

	}

	lawgroup_distribution_of_power = {

		law_oligarchy = neutral
		law_landed_voting = approve	
		law_wealth_voting = approve	
		law_census_voting = neutral		
		law_universal_suffrage = disapprove
		law_anarchy = strongly_disapprove
		law_technocracy = strongly_disapprove
		law_military_junta = disapprove
		law_organic_democracy = strongly_disapprove
		law_proletariat_dictatorship = strongly_disapprove
		law_ecclesiarchy = neutral
		law_weighted_universal_voting = disapprove	# laws+
	}

	lawgroup_economic_system = {	
		law_laissez_faire = neutral
		law_interventionism = disapprove
		law_agrarianism = strongly_disapprove
		law_traditionalism = strongly_disapprove		
		law_cooperative_ownership = strongly_disapprove		
		law_command_economy = strongly_disapprove
		law_industry_banned = neutral
		law_extraction_economy = strongly_disapprove
		law_state_capitalism = disapprove
		law_class_collaboration = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
		law_early_industrialization = disapprove	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_trade_policy = {
		law_free_trade = strongly_approve
		law_mercantilism = disapprove
		law_protectionism = disapprove		
		law_isolationism = strongly_disapprove
		law_sakoku_shugi = strongly_disapprove	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_repeatable_economy = {
		law_repeatable_economy_liberalization = strongly_approve
		law_repeatable_economy_agricultural_investment = neutral
		law_repeatable_economy_peasant_corvee = disapprove
		law_repeatable_economy_public_works = strongly_disapprove
		law_repeatable_economy_forced_industrialization = strongly_disapprove
	}

	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_orleanist_valid_trigger = yes
	}

	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 200
		# less likely in a theocracy
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_theocracy
				}
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# less likely if IG is happy in a republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy }
				}
				ig_approval > 0
			}
			add = -100
		}

		# more likely for intelligentsia, industrialists, and PB with traditional economic laws
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
					is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
					is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
					is_interest_group_type = ig_conservatives
					}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_agrarianism
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_traditionalism
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_isolationism
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_mercantilism
					}
				}
			}
			add = 75
		}
		# more likely if the IG is unhappy with the monarchy, and that monarchy is not Orleanist
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
					NOT = { has_variable = orleanist_restoration_var }
				}
				ig_approval < 0
			}
			add = 75
		}

		# reduced unhappy modifier if it's not a monarchy
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy }
					NOT = { has_variable = orleanist_restoration_var }
				}
				ig_approval < 0
			}
			add = 25
		}
		# conservative and/or reactionary leaders have a higher spawn chance if the Anti-Dreyfusards won.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = anti_dreyfusard_victory
			}
			add = 50
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_orleanist_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		always = no
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 100
	}
	lawgroup_ballot_system = {
		law_direct_democracy = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_no_election = disapprove	# derived
		law_non_secret_ballot = approve	# derived
		law_secret_ballot = disapprove	# derived

	}

			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk
					is_interest_group_type = ig_agrarian_populists
				}
			}
			add = 75
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk
					is_interest_group_type = ig_agrarian_populists
				}
				ig_approval < 0
			}
			add = 75
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy }
				}
				ig_approval > 0
			}
			add = -100
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_donghak_ideology_valid_trigger = yes
		}
		#always = no
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 100
	}
	lawgroup_ballot_system = {
		law_direct_democracy = strongly_approve	# derived
		law_no_election = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_non_secret_ballot = neutral	# derived
		law_secret_ballot = approve	# derived
		law_semi_constitutional = neutral	# derived
	}
}

# ideology_dove
REPLACE:ideology_dove = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_pacifist.dds"
	
	character_ideology = yes
	show_in_list = yes
	lawgroup_foreign_policy = {
		law_ultramilitarism = strongly_disapprove
		law_jingoism = strongly_disapprove
		law_flexible_foreign_policy = disapprove
		law_justum_bellum = approve
		law_dove_politics = strongly_approve
		law_armed_neutrality = approve
		law_disarmed_nation = disapprove
		law_premodern_diplomacy = disapprove
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_dove_ideology_leader_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 50
		# emerges to counter powerful armed forces
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					ig:ig_armed_forces = {
						is_powerful = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 100
		}
		# less likely if not very militaristic
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					bpm_country_laws_foreign_policy_hawk = no
				}
			}
			add = -50
		}
		# more likely to keep peace
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					bpm_country_laws_foreign_policy_dove = yes
				}
			}
			add = 250
		}
		# more likely if a war you started isn't going well
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_at_war = yes
					any_scope_war = {
						attacker_warleader = { this = ROOT.owner }
						has_war_support = {
							target = root.owner
							value < 0
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = 200
		}
		# more likely with devastation in incorporated states
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_scope_state = {
						is_incorporated = yes
						devastation > 20
					}
				}
			}
			add = 300
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_dove_ideology_leader_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitators should have an ideology at odds with current laws
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = { bpm_country_laws_foreign_policy_dove = no }
		}
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 50
	}
	lawgroup_army_model = {
		law_amabutho = disapprove	# derived
	}
}

# ideology_revolutionary_hawk
REPLACE:ideology_revolutionary_hawk = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_jingoist.dds"
	
	character_ideology = yes
	show_in_list = yes
	lawgroup_foreign_policy = {
		law_ultramilitarism = strongly_disapprove
		law_jingoism = approve
		law_flexible_foreign_policy = neutral
		law_justum_bellum = strongly_approve
		law_dove_politics = disapprove
		law_armed_neutrality = disapprove
		law_disarmed_nation = strongly_disapprove
		law_premodern_diplomacy = strongly_disapprove
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_revolutionary_hawk_valid_trigger = yes
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
    		ideology_revolutionary_hawk_valid_trigger = yes
    	}
		# Agitators should have an ideology at odds with current laws
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = { bpm_country_laws_foreign_policy_dove = yes }
		}
		owner = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 50
		# less likely if issues are not relevant
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					bpm_country_laws_foreign_policy_hawk = yes
				}
			}
			add = -100
		}
		# more likely if you border a rival
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_rival_country = {
						any_neighbouring_state = {
							owner = root.owner
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# Having rivals makes for concerned socialists
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_rival_country = {
						count >= 1
					}
				}
			}
			add = 100
		}
		# Infamy makes them go "fuck it we ball"
		if = {
			limit = {
				"owner.infamy" >= infamy_threshold:infamous
			}
			add = 100
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				"owner.infamy" >= infamy_threshold:notorious
			}
			add = 100
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				"owner.infamy" >= infamy_threshold:pariah
			}
			add = 100
		}
		# more likely if you're the defender in a war
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_at_war = yes
					any_scope_war = {
						defender_warleader = { this = ROOT.owner }
					}
				}
			}
			add = 200
		}
	}

	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 50
	}
	lawgroup_army_model = {
		law_amabutho = strongly_disapprove	# derived
	}
}

		law_proletariat_dictatorship = disapprove	# derived
		law_weighted_universal_voting = approve	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_bureaucracy = {
		law_elected_bureaucrats = disapprove
		law_appointed_bureaucrats = strongly_approve
		law_hereditary_bureaucrats = strongly_disapprove

	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {

			ideology_reconstructionist_valid_trigger = yes
		}
		NOT = { has_role_of_type = agitator }
	}

	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {has_journal_entry = je_bpm_second_revolution}
			}
			add = -100
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 100
		# less likely if issues are not relevant

				}
			}

# ideology_reactionary_anti_capitalist
REPLACE:ideology_reactionary_anti_capitalist = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/unused/ideology_leader_reactionary.dds"
	
	character_ideology = yes
	show_in_list = yes

	lawgroup_church_and_state = {
		law_state_religion = approve
		law_freedom_of_conscience = approve
		law_total_separation = strongly_disapprove
		law_state_atheism = strongly_disapprove
		law_religious_pluralism = approve	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_trade_policy = {		
		law_protectionism = strongly_approve
		law_mercantilism = approve		
		law_isolationism = disapprove
		law_free_trade = strongly_disapprove
		law_sakoku_shugi = disapprove	# derived
	}

    lawgroup_education_system = {
		law_no_schools = disapprove
		law_religious_schools = strongly_approve
		law_private_schools = neutral
		law_public_schools = approve
		law_military_schools = strongly_approve	# derived
		law_seodang = strongly_approve	# derived
	}

    lawgroup_labor_rights = {
		law_no_workers_rights = neutral
		law_regulatory_bodies = approve
		law_worker_protections = strongly_approve
		law_paradox_employee_benefits = strongly_approve	# derived
		law_union_representation = strongly_approve	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_economic_system = {
		law_traditionalism = strongly_disapprove
		law_interventionism = approve
		law_agrarianism = strongly_approve
		law_industry_banned = strongly_approve
		law_laissez_faire = neutral
		law_cooperative_ownership = strongly_approve
		law_command_economy = disapprove
		law_extraction_economy = strongly_disapprove
		law_class_collaboration = neutral	# derived
		law_early_industrialization = disapprove	# derived
		law_state_capitalism = neutral	# derived
	}

    lawgroup_land_reform = {
		law_serfdom = strongly_disapprove
		law_tenant_farmers = approve
		law_peasant_proprietorship = approve
		law_commercialized_agriculture = neutral
		law_collectivized_agriculture = strongly_disapprove
	}

    lawgroup_welfare = {
		law_no_social_security = neutral
		law_poor_laws = neutral
		law_wage_subsidies = approve
		law_old_age_pension = strongly_approve
		law_disability_insurance = strongly_approve	# derived
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_reactionary_anti_capitalist_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 50
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_liberal = yes
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_national_liberals }	
			}
			add = -50
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { has_variable = local_patcon_split_var }
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_national_liberals
					is_interest_group_type = ig_conservatives
					is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# not very relevant if issues are already addressed
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
					}
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_public_schools
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_regulatory_bodies
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_wage_subsidies
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_corporatized_unions
				}
			}
			add = -25
		}
		# less likely for landowners and devout
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# more likely for content trade unions and rural folk outside of council republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_lower_institutional = yes
				ig_approval >= 0
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
				}
			}
			add = 25
		}
		# conservative and/or reactionary leaders have a higher spawn chance if the Anti-Dreyfusards won
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = anti_dreyfusard_victory
			}
			add = 25
		}

		# conservative and/or reactionary leaders have a higher spawn chance if you win the Two Spains as the conservatives.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = spa_two_spains_conservative_victory
			}
			add = 25
		}

	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
        interest_group = {
			ideology_reactionary_anti_capitalist_valid_trigger = yes
    		OR = {
				bpm_ig_is_rural_institutional = yes
				is_interest_group_type = ig_reactionaries
			}
    	}
	}
	
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 100
	}
}

# ideology_carlist
REPLACE:ideology_carlist = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_carlist.dds"

	character_ideology = yes

	lawgroup_governance_principles = {
		law_monarchy = strongly_approve
		law_presidential_republic = disapprove
		law_parliamentary_republic = disapprove
		law_corporate_state = neutral
		law_theocracy = disapprove
		law_council_republic = strongly_disapprove
		law_corporatocracy = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
	}

	lawgroup_economic_system = {
		law_traditionalism = strongly_approve
		law_agrarianism = approve
		law_interventionism = disapprove
		law_industry_banned = disapprove
		law_laissez_faire = disapprove
		law_cooperative_ownership = strongly_disapprove
		law_command_economy = strongly_disapprove
		law_extraction_economy = disapprove
		law_state_capitalism = neutral	# laws+
		law_class_collaboration = disapprove	# laws+
		law_early_industrialization = neutral	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_distribution_of_power = {
		law_oligarchy = approve
		law_autocracy = strongly_approve # Were opposed to absolutism, but the game defines Oligarchy as a bourgeois system
		law_single_party_state = strongly_disapprove
		law_landed_voting = disapprove
		law_wealth_voting = strongly_disapprove
		law_census_voting = strongly_disapprove
		law_universal_suffrage = strongly_disapprove
		law_anarchy = strongly_disapprove
		law_technocracy = strongly_disapprove
		law_organic_democracy = disapprove
		law_weighted_universal_voting = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
		law_proletariat_dictatorship = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
		law_ecclesiarchy = neutral	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_citizenship = {
		law_ethnostate = neutral
		law_subjecthood = approve
		law_national_supremacy = neutral
		law_racial_segregation = neutral
		law_cultural_exclusion = neutral
		law_multicultural = disapprove
		law_cosmopolitanism = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_hellenoturkism = neutral	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_church_and_state = {
		law_state_religion = strongly_approve
		law_freedom_of_conscience = disapprove
		law_total_separation = strongly_disapprove
		law_state_atheism = strongly_disapprove
		law_religious_pluralism = strongly_disapprove	# laws+
	}

	lawgroup_centralization = {
		law_unitary = disapprove
		law_devolved = strongly_approve
		law_federated = approve
		law_confederated = neutral
		law_ad_hoc_centralization = disapprove
	}

	country_trigger = {
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:spanish # I am in Spain...
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:catalan # ...without the S
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:basque # ...without the A
		}
		NOR = {
			any_interest_group = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_paternalistic
			}
			has_variable = monarchy_stamped_out_var
		}
	}

	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_carlist_valid_trigger = yes
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		# Agitators should have an ideology at odds with current laws
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_traditionalism
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_oligarchy
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_subjecthood
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_religion
			}
		}
		interest_group = {
			ideology_carlist_valid_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	interest_group_leader_weight = { # Provisional weights
		value = 200
		# less likely in a theocracy
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_theocracy
				}
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# less likely if IG is happy in a republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy }
				}
				ig_approval > 0
			}
			add = -100
		}

		# more likely for LO and Devout
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
					is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}

		# more likely if the IG is unhappy with the monarchy, and that monarchy is not Carlist
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
					NOT = { ruler ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_carlist } }
				}
				ig_approval < 0
			}
			add = 75
		}

		# reduced unhappy modifier if it's not a monarchy
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy }
					NOT = { ruler ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_carlist } }
				}
				ig_approval < 0
			}
			add = 25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_variable = communist_ig_var
					has_variable = chose_vanguardism
					has_variable = chose_anarchism
					has_variable = chose_communism
					has_variable = chose_ethno_nationalism
					has_variable = chose_conservatism
					has_variable = chose_fascism
				}
			}
			multiply = 0.1
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 200
		# less likely in a theocracy
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_theocracy
				}
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# less likely if IG is happy in a republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy }
				}
				interest_group.ig_approval > 0
			}
			add = -100
		}

		# more likely for LO and Devout
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
					is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}

		# more likely if the IG is unhappy with the monarchy, and that monarchy is not Carlist
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy
					NOT = { ruler ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_carlist } }
				}
				interest_group.ig_approval < 0
			}
			add = 75
		}

		# reduced unhappy modifier if it's not a monarchy
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_monarchy }
					NOT = { ruler ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_carlist } }
				}
				interest_group.ig_approval < 0
			}
			add = 25
		}

		# conservative and/or reactionary leaders have a higher spawn chance if you win the Two Spains as the conservatives.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = spa_two_spains_conservative_victory
			}
			add = 50
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_variable = communist_ig_var
					has_variable = chose_vanguardism
					has_variable = chose_anarchism
					has_variable = chose_communism
					has_variable = chose_ethno_nationalism
					has_variable = chose_conservatism
					has_variable = chose_fascism
				}
			}
			multiply = 0.1
		}
	}
	lawgroup_ballot_system = {
		law_direct_democracy = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_no_election = strongly_approve	# derived
		law_non_secret_ballot = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_secret_ballot = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_semi_constitutional = disapprove	# derived
	}
	lawgroup_discriminated_pop = {
		law_no_codified_discrimination = disapprove	# derived
		law_racial_hierarchy = neutral	# derived
		law_violent_suppresion = neutral	# derived
	}
}

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = spa_two_spains_conservative_victory
			}
			add = 50
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_variable = communist_ig_var
					has_variable = chose_vanguardism
					has_variable = chose_anarchism
					has_variable = chose_communism
					has_variable = chose_ethno_nationalism
					has_variable = chose_conservatism
					has_variable = chose_fascism
				}
			}
			multiply = 0.1
		}
	}
	lawgroup_ballot_system = {
		law_direct_democracy = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_no_election = strongly_approve	# derived
		law_non_secret_ballot = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_secret_ballot = strongly_disapprove	# derived
		law_semi_constitutional = disapprove	# derived
	}
	lawgroup_discriminated_pop = {
		law_no_codified_discrimination = disapprove	# derived
		law_racial_hierarchy = neutral	# derived
		law_violent_suppresion = neutral	# derived
	}
}

		law_right_of_assembly = approve

		law_outlawed_dissent = strongly_disapprove
	}

	country_trigger = {

	}

		ideology_ilustrado_leader_valid_trigger = yes
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {

		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_public_schools
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_protected_speech
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_total_separation
			}
		}
		interest_group = {
			ideology_ilustrado_leader_valid_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 100
		# More likely for Intelligentsia
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
			}
			add = 50
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 100
		# More likely if je_philippines_main is completed
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_variable = je_philippines_main_complete_happened
						has_variable = je_philippines_main_reliance_happened

					}
				}
			}
			add = 25
		}
	}
	lawgroup_discriminated_pop = {
		law_no_codified_discrimination = disapprove	# derived
		law_racial_hierarchy = neutral	# derived
		law_violent_suppresion = strongly_disapprove	# derived
	}
}

	}

		law_migration_controls = neutral
		law_no_migration_controls = disapprove
	}

	lawgroup_economic_system = {

		law_cooperative_ownership = strongly_disapprove
		law_command_economy = neutral
		law_interventionism = approve
		law_agrarianism = disapprove
		law_traditionalism = strongly_disapprove
		law_laissez_faire = neutral
		law_industry_banned = strongly_disapprove
		law_state_capitalism = approve	# laws+
		law_class_collaboration = disapprove	# laws+
		law_early_industrialization = strongly_disapprove	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_taxation = {
		law_per_capita_based_taxation = approve
		law_proportional_taxation = strongly_approve
		law_graduated_taxation = strongly_approve
		law_land_based_taxation = neutral
		law_consumption_based_taxation = disapprove
		law_no_income_tax = disapprove	# laws+
	}

	lawgroup_education_system = {
		law_public_schools = approve
		law_private_schools = neutral
		law_religious_schools = neutral
		law_no_schools = disapprove
		law_military_schools = neutral	# laws+
		law_seodang = neutral	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_army_model = {
		law_national_militia = disapprove
		law_professional_army = neutral
		law_peasant_levies = disapprove
		law_mass_conscription = approve
		law_amabutho = disapprove	# derived
	}

	lawgroup_navy_model = {
		law_merchant_navy = disapprove
		law_jeune_ecole = approve
		law_professional_navy = neutral
		law_diplomatic_navy = neutral
	}

	lawgroup_edo_social_system = {
		law_strict_edo_system = disapprove
		law_intermediate_edo_system = neutral
		law_lax_edo_system = approve
	}

	country_trigger = {
		c:JAP ?= this
		has_technology_researched = academia
		is_country_type = unrecognized
	}

	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_modernizer_leader_valid_trigger = yes
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		# Agitators should have an ideology at odds with current laws
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_closed_borders
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_interventionism
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_public_schools
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_mass_conscription
				OR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_proportional_taxation
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_graduated_taxation
				}
			}
		}
	}

	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		add = {
			value = 100
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		# More likely for Petty Bourgeoisie
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "ig_petty_bourgeoisie"
			}
		}
		# More likely if Unrecognized Country
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_country_type = unrecognized
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "unrecognized_power"
			}
		}
		# More likely in countries with a large urban center
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_scope_state = {
						any_scope_building = {
							is_building_type = building_urban_center
							level >= 10
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 25
				desc = "URBANIZATION"
			}
		}
	}

	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 100
		# More likely if Unrecognized Country
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_country_type = unrecognized
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# More likely in countries with a large urban center
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_scope_state = {
						any_scope_building = {
							is_building_type = building_urban_center
							level >= 10
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = 25
		}
	}
}
